aberration_engrams.name: Aberration Engrams
aberration_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes from the Aberration DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

engram_creation.name: Engram Creation
engram_creation.description: You possess the knowledge to create Engrams and implant them into the minds of others. These Engrams allow you to share recipes, blueprints, and crafting knowledge you possess with other people, including technology that would normally be uncraftable, such as tinkertech and similar creations from your other perks. However, Engrams have strict limits on complexity; you cannot share the ability to construct every type of technology. This perk works best with technology from ARK, but you can gradually learn to encode creations from other perks you possess. Once implanted, a person can craft whatever technology you've included in the Engram as if they knew it themselves.

extinction_engrams.name: Extinction Engrams
extinction_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes from the Extinction DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

genesis_engrams.name: Genesis Engrams
genesis_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes from Genesis: Parts 1 & 2 DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

high_engrams.name: High Engrams
high_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes from levels 51 to 100 from the base ARK: Survival Evolved game, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

low_engrams.name: Low Engrams
low_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes up to level 50 from the base ARK: Survival Evolved game, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

scorched_earth_engrams.name: Scorched Earth Engrams
scorched_earth_engrams.description: You gain access to all engram recipes from the Scorched Earth DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved, along with the basic skills needed to use these creations.

tek_recipes.name: Tek Recipes
tek_recipes.description: You gain access to all Tekgram recipes from the base ARK: Survival Evolved game, along with the basic skills to use these creations and limited scientific understanding of the underlying technology.

tekgrams_creation.name: Tekgrams Creation
tekgrams_creation.description: You have mastered the creation of Tekgrams and their implantation into the minds of others. These Tekgrams let you share any recipes, blueprints, or crafting knowledge you possess, including uncraftable technology like tinkertech and similar creations from your perks. This serves as a direct upgrade to standard Engrams, allowing you to share the capability to build any technology you know, one Tekgram at a time. Requires Engram Creation. If you do not possess that perk, purchasing Tekgrams will automatically grant Engram Creation as well (for free), provided you have enough CP.

valaknots.name: Valaknots
valaknots.description: Valaknots are ancient symbols that warp body and mind when carved into flesh. Believed to be gifted to mortals by the god of change, Maudamouros, these symbols allow the manipulation of living creatures - including animals, plants, and fungi. Valaknots do not work on dead material; they require living entities. They can reshape bodies, empowering or diminishing them in countless ways, and can even grant some the power to conjure or manipulate different matter. Valaknots are arranged into patterns called Valachains. Mistakes in carving will lead to consequences. You have the expertise and carving skills of a decently experienced Valaknot practitioner, but without a specific focus or tradition. You possess your own rather humble mental library of randomly chosen Valaknots: you know what they do and how they mesh together into various Valachains. By spending additional 200 CP (or more), you can buy proficiency in one of the specific traditions of the art: The Flesh Forge, The Saltfen Brood, The Fellwood Druids. By personally instructing and guiding others, you might give them ability to use and teach others the art of Valaknots. (Author: Creature Guild)

electromagnetism.name: Electromagnetism
electromagnetism.description: "Maxwell's equations poetically describe electricity and magnetism intertwining. With a deeper understanding, machines can be created for acquiring and using electrical energy with high efficiency." This perk grants you the scientific knowledge and complete blueprints needed to create all devices unlocked by the Electromagnetism technology from Dyson Sphere Program: including basic wind turbines, tesla towers, and foundational power infrastructure.

end_game_technology.name: End Game Technology
end_game_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from Tier Thirteen and above technology levels of Dyson Sphere Program. This represents the absolute pinnacle of achievable advancement. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave catastrophic gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps will manifest as extreme tinkertech limitations - your creations will function only because the perk forces them to, you will comprehend almost nothing of how they work, replication by others will be impossible, and even you may struggle to maintain them without constant reference to your internal blueprints. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

icarus_mecha.name: Icarus Mecha
icarus_mecha.description: You possess the blueprint and extensive practical skills needed to construct the basic Icarus mecha from Dyson Sphere Program, along with the ability to maintain and operate this machine effectively. However, your knowledge of its inner workings is incomplete: you can build it and make it function, but you do not fully understand why it works. This incomplete understanding grants significant tinkertech cheating potential: you can cut corners, substitute materials, and force the mecha into existence through sheer applied supernatural ability, though such shortcuts may have consequences. More importantly, you gain access to the full Icarus upgrade tech tree, which you can explore and progress through over time. Advancement speed depends on how extensively you use your current mecha and on your dedicated research efforts. However, progression becomes increasingly difficult the further you go: from the simple Tier One upgrades all the way to the pinnacle of Tier Eight and beyond.

tier_eight_technology.name: Tier Eight Technology
tier_eight_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from the Tier Eight technology level of Dyson Sphere Program. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave significant gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps may manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches or blind spots in your theoretical knowledge regarding precursor technologies. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

tier_eleven_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from the Tier Eleven technology level of Dyson Sphere Program. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave significant gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps will manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches: your creations will function reliably in your hands, but you will not truly comprehend the underlying principles, and replication by others will prove nearly impossible. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

alchemillia_tome.name: Alchemillia Tome
alchemillia_tome.description: This tome contains all three volumes of Alchemillia - a comprehensive guide for beginner, intermediate, and experienced alchemists. It allows you to learn and use alchemy skills from the Fear & Hunger games, even in worlds where such knowledge should not exist or function. Copies you make of the original book still work to grant skills, but their power diminishes in proportion to how little personal effort you invested in creating them. Copies made from other copies diminish further still.

bloody_engrave.name: Bloody Engrave
bloody_engrave.description: You have the skill and knowledge to engrave sigils on yourself or willing party members. Each sigil's benefit varies depending on the god it represents. Historically, these markings were carved across the body, though modern practitioners prefer facial sigils for greater efficiency. You can consistently create and utilize these sigils from Fear & Hunger game, unlocking their effects.

hungry_and_afraid.name: Hungry & Afraid
hungry_and_afraid.description: You are something of an expert when it comes to dealing with hunger and fear. While you don't have actual experience, you possess many unique practical skills, useful trivia, and helpful habits to call upon when needed. This includes not only things like finding food or knowing how to cook and eat usually inedible items, but also strategies such as psyching yourself up to consume something gross or how to use drugs to relieve stress while minimizing the chances of psychological addiction. You know various techniques to cope with fear and stress, and have an aptitude for managing feelings of hunger and exhaustion.

medicinal.name: Medicinal
medicinal.description: You can perform the Medicinal ritual, sacrificing harvested organs to Vitruvia, the architect of the human body. A proper sacrifice will cure the corresponding status ailment, based on the principle that every action has an equal reaction. You possess the ability, skill, and knowledge to utilize this ritual consistently.

ritual_circles.name: Ritual Circles
ritual_circles.description: You possess the ability, skills, and knowledge to create and use ritual circles from the Fear & Hunger games. Unlike the circles available in the games, yours offer expanded functionality and versatility. Be cautious - these circles connect to the divine entities from their source setting and draw upon their authorities, which may attract unwanted attention or introduce unsettling phenomena into your current reality. You are capable of teaching this art to others, allowing the practice to spread from person to person. All infohazardous knowledge is locked away from you, if it would harm you to know.

aetherial_lore.name: Aetherial Lore
aetherial_lore.description: "Foolishly and greedily did the arcanists of Cairn delve into the magical veil known as the Aether, never once suspecting that something was looking back. The Aetherials descended upon Cairn in what is now known as the Grim Dawn, possessing countless humans and butchering the rest. Most despicably of all, they began raising the fallen as mutated undead creatures, mindless foot soldiers for their invasion. Their very presence on Cairn is enough to mutate the wildlife, turning once docile creatures into vicious monstrosities. But most strange of all is their apparent hatred for Chthonians, as they will battle against the horrors from the Void at every opportunity." You gain a deep insight into Aetherial lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries to cause a version of 'Grim Dawn' in your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

arcanist_path.name: Arcanist Path
arcanist_path.description: To Arcanists, the manifestation of magic is not some unexplainable mystery or the will of the gods, but a science meant to be unraveled. This pursuit of knowledge drives all Arcanists, always eager to discover a new technique to make their namesake. Arcanists warp the mysterious aether and elements to their will, creating devastating demonstrations of power that rival small armies. However, such raw force leaves little in terms of defense. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Arcanist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

augment_making_recipes.name: Augment Making Recipes
augment_making_recipes.description: "Augments are enchanted powders, tinctures and poisons that can be used to empower weapons, rings, and amulets. An item may have only one augment on it at any given time, and applying a new augment overwrites the old one. Salvaging or dismantling an augmented item does not return the augment." You gain ability to craft all augments from the game, apply them effectively. You can even tweak recipes slightly or use auguments in creative ways. However, you only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. Although, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

chthonian_lore.name: Chthonian Lore
chthonian_lore.description: "Chthonians, horrors from the Void, are the things of nightmares. Prior to the Grim Dawn, Chthonians would only be seen upon Cairn following an arcane ritual gone wrong or at the beckoning of a powerful sorcerer. Despite an effort to exterminate the practice, a cult has formed around blood rituals and the worship of Chthonic beings. Members of the cult have been overheard chanting one name in particular: Ch'thon. With the world in disarray, the cult has grown strong, garnering new followers desperate for answers in a world that no longer makes sense. Chthonians, and their loyal cult, appear to be at odds with the Aetherials, eagerly harvesting helpless humans for blood so that the Aetherials cannot use them as vessels." You gain a deep insight into Chthonian lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries so that things from the Void can slip into your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

components_creation.name: Components Creation
components_creation.description: You are able to produce components from the Grim Dawn game using relatively mundane resources. You also can apply or utilize them on different pieces of equipment to affect their properties or add new ones. This process is quite mysterious, just like the resulting components.

consumables_recipes.name: Consumables Recipes
consumables_recipes.description: You gain the mental compendium of all recipes, which can be found and collected in the game, to produce consumables and the ability to make them. You only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. However, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

demolitionist_path.name: Demolitionist Path
demolitionist_path.description: Pyrotechnic masters of the imperial army, Demolitionists are part engineer, part sorcerer. They were used to break enemy ranks and breach fortifications with their devastating array of explosives and destructive magic. They usually prefer to fight at range, engaging enemies with guns, traps and explosives but they can also be proficient with melee weapons. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Demolitionist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

devotion_constellations.name: Devotion Constellations
devotion_constellations.description: This perk gives you one devotion point to spend on stars from Grim Dawn constellations, granting you some boons and effects the have. Although they are not the same as in the game, they are inspired by it and warped by the actual meanings and ideas these constellations represent, and your personality, your nature. You have a general knowledge of their lore. Be careful, because this might have some unexpected side effects. This perk can be purchased multiple times. You don't have to spend the obtained devotion points - they can be stored indefinitely and used whenever you feel like it. After buying all the stars from all the constellations, you gain the ability to give these points to other people after each purchase of the perk.

inquisitor_path.name: Inquisitor Path
inquisitor_path.description: Trained by the secretive Luminari Order, inquisitors were officially sanctioned by the Erulan Emperor to hunt down and eliminate all eldritch and arcane threats to the empire. This dangerous and thankless duty necessitated some unconventional means of combat, including using the powers of their very enemies against them. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Inquisitor Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

necromancer_path.name: Necromancer Path
necromancer_path.description: Although they primarily engage in the weaving of magic, necromancers are aptly equipped to enter the fray in close quarters, or to weave their death magic into ranged weaponry. Do not for a moment think that a cornered necromancer is easy prey. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Necromancer Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

nightblade_path.name: Nightblade Path
nightblade_path.description: Nightblades were clandestine warriors that sold their services to the great houses of the empire. Nightblades excel with all manner of martial weapons, but are even more feared for the deadly blade magic that is the secret of their trade. Nightblades are not suited to go toe to toe with tougher enemies and rely on illusion to close for quick, devastating attacks or fight from a distance with phantasmal blades. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Nightblade Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

oathkeeper_path.name: Oathkeeper Path
oathkeeper_path.description: Driven by divine purpose and celestial fire in their hearts, Oathkeepers are a terror to the enemies of humanity. Their wills unbending, their faith their shield. None can withstand the righteous fury of a fully trained Oathkeeper. Oathkeepers may be servants of divine forces, but such forces may not always hold humanity in high regard or be sanctioned by the fallen Erulan Empire. Some Oathkeepers serve dark and corrupted powers, others see salvation in the light of Empyrion; others still believe that the Witch Gods are the only true gods and through their blessing they become a force of change upon Cairn. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Oathkeeper Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

occultist_path.name: Occultist Path
occultist_path.description: Once hunted by imperial forces in an effort to control eldritch power, the Occultist's craft focuses heavily on summoning and borrowed powers granted by the three witch gods" Bysmiel, Solael and Dreeg. Their diverse arts include abhorrent curses and spells that inflict damage with poison, acid, and entropic energy. Excelling with neither sword nor gun, they can use either to augment their offense." You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Occultist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

shaman_path.name: Shaman Path
shaman_path.description: Hailing from the untamed northlands, Shamans were the spiritual leaders and guardians of their people. Claiming an astounding attunement to the wilds and their patron deity Mogdrogen, Shamans are capable of wielding the terrible forces of nature against their foes or even calling upon savage beasts to come to their aid. Shamans excel in the use of brutal two-handed melee weapons, but can easily adapt to other tools of war when conjuring their primal powers. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Shaman Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

soldier_path.name: Soldier Path
soldier_path.description: Soldiers of the imperial army were trained to survive in the most hellish conditions and hold the line against the nastiest enemies of the empire. Soldiers prefer the use of close combat weaponry, such as a sword and shield, but can also prove formidable with firearms. What a Soldier may lack in outright damage output is made up for in fortitude and leadership. You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Soldier Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

advanced_autonomous_industries.name: Advanced Autonomous Industries
advanced_autonomous_industries.description: This perk provides you with complete blueprints for every craftable item, machine, vehicle, and structure from the Advanced Autonomous Industries mod (AAI) for Factorio, including all its various modules, addons, and expansions. Beyond simple blueprints, you receive just enough scientific and engineering knowledge to somewhat understand how your creations function: allowing you to troubleshoot issues rather than blindly following instructions. You also gain the practical skills needed to utilize, construct, and reliably maintain this complex automation technology, ensuring your programmable vehicles, scanners, and autonomous systems continue operating long after they leave your workbench.

bobs_electronics.name: Bob's Electronics
bobs_electronics.description: You gain the ability to create entirely new electronics production chains inspired by Bob's Electronics mod for Factorio: from basic components to advanced circuit boards and processing units. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_greenhouse.name: Bob's Greenhouse
bobs_greenhouse.description: You gain the ability to construct greenhouses from Bob's Greenhouse mod for Factorio - bizarre and unnaturally efficient structures that produce wood from water and a small seed stock. While not magical, their effectiveness defies simple explanation. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_logistics.name: Bob's Logistics
bobs_logistics.description: You gain the ability to construct all logistics-related devices and systems added by the Bob's Logistics mod for Factorio, including higher-tier belts, inserters, pipes, and storage solutions. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_materials.name: Bob's Materials
bobs_materials.description: This perk provides a complete mental compendium and blueprints for all resource processing and material production chains from Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates, and Bob's Ores mods. You understand how to extract, refine, and utilize the full spectrum of ores and materials these mods introduce. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_mining.name: Bob's Mining
bobs_mining.description: You gain the ability to build and use all new mining machines and excavation tools added by the Bob's Mining mod for Factorio, including advanced miners, ore refining equipment, and resource extraction upgrades. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_modules.name: Bob's Modules
bobs_modules.description: You gain the ability to manufacture and utilize all modules added by Bob's Modules mod for Factorio: including productivity, speed, efficiency, and their various advanced tiers and combinations. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_personal_equipment.name: Bob's Personal Equipment
bobs_personal_equipment.description: You gain the ability to create and use all pieces of personal equipment added by Bob's Personal Equipment mod for Factorio, including modular armor, advanced batteries, exoskeletons, personal shields, and night vision enhancements. This perk synergizes greatly with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_power.name: Bob's Power
bobs_power.description: You gain the ability to construct all new power generation structures and energy systems added by the Bob's Power mod for Factorio, including advanced boilers, steam engines, and higher-tier energy infrastructure. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_tech.name: Bob's Tech
bobs_tech.description: This perk provides deep theoretical knowledge about the technologies introduced by other Bob's Mods. It does not grant blueprints or specific applied knowledge, but instead fills in the conceptual gaps and allows you to integrate elements from different Bob's mods into coherent technological systems. With this foundation, you can explore more non-tinkertech solutions and truly understand how your creations work. Knowledge accumulates slowly over time, but the process accelerates dramatically when you actually build and use items from your other Bob's mod perks.

bobs_vehicle_equipment.name: Bob's Vehicle Equipment
bobs_vehicle_equipment.description: You gain the ability to build and use all equipment added by Bob's Vehicle Equipment mod for Factorio: including vehicle grids, energy shields, repair packs, and specialized modules for your rolling stock. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

bobs_warfare.name: Bob's Warfare
bobs_warfare.description: You gain the ability to create all warfare-related devices and weapon systems added by the Bob's Warfare mod for Factorio - including new turrets, ammunition types, armor, and combat equipment. This perk synergizes powerfully with other Bob's mods. On its own, your creations will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but poorly understood. However, as you acquire more Bob's mod perks, this limitation gradually fades. Each additional Bob's mod provides missing context and foundational knowledge, transforming your tinkertech constructions into true, replicable technology. Although, other perks or suitable areas of knowledge might play similar role.

electric_weapons.name: Electric Weapons
electric_weapons.description: Inspired by the mod of the same name, this perk adds several blueprints of electric weaponry to your mental compendium, including plasma rifles, laser-based arms, and other high-tech armaments. Alongside these blueprints, you receive in-depth scientific knowledge of how each weapon functions, from power cells to focusing arrays. You also gain a significant degree of practical skill in using these weapons effectively in combat, as well as the expertise needed to modify, repair, and customize them for different tactical situations.

factory_planner.name: Factory Planner
factory_planner.description: This perk provides you with a collection of specialized software tools and simple companion devices designed for planning complex production lines. These programs allow you to map out recipes, calculate resource requirements, specify machine configurations, and optimize assembly line layouts before building a single structure. Beyond the tools themselves, you gain sufficient computer science knowledge and design skills to actually create, modify, and utilize these planning applications effectively: ensuring you can adapt your planning methods to whatever manufacturing challenges you face.

infinite_source.name: Infinite Source
infinite_source.description: Once purchased, this perk allows you to select one existing resource deposit within your immediate vicinity and apply a replenishing quality to it. The chosen source will become endlessly renewable: gradually restoring itself over time as long as you do not mine it too aggressively. The speed of replenishment depends on the nature of the material. Common resources like coal regenerate quickly, while rarer or more complex substances like redstone restore at a much slower rate. Additionally, the farther a resource deviates from Factorio-style materials in nature and complexity, the less effective this replenishing effect becomes. There is an upper limit to both the size and complexity of deposits that can be targeted: massive or exceptionally intricate formations may be beyond this perk's ability to affect. The effect is not disruptive to things around the deposit and machines mining it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 400 CP) stacking another activation in storage. You may hold these effects indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable target before spending them.

krastorio.name: Krastorio
krastorio.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of all blueprints for craftable items from the Krastorio mod for Factorio, along with enough basic theoretical understanding to somewhat grasp how this advanced technology functions. However, this knowledge does not exist in a vacuum. If you lack sufficient contextual understanding from other Factorio perks (particularly foundational technologies like red, green, or blue science) there will be significant gaps in your comprehension. These gaps will manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches: you can still build the items, but you won't truly understand why they work, and your creations will be difficult for others to replicate or maintain. The higher tiers of Krastorio technology require genuine understanding of the underlying principles. Without that foundation, pushing too far into advanced tech may have... Interesting consequences.

modular_turrets.name: Modular Turrets
modular_turrets.description: Inspired by the Modular Turrets mod for Factorio, this perk grants you complete blueprints and sufficient skills to build, operate, and maintain the full range of turrets from the mod. You understand their modular construction principles and can customize your defensive installations with various barrels, ammunition types, and support systems to suit any tactical situation. These machines offer remarkable flexibility in construction approach. You can build them as tinkertech (quick, cheap, and reliable in your hands alone) or invest the time and resources to construct them as true technology that others can understand, replicate, and maintain independently.

pyanodons_addons.name: Pyanodons Addons
pyanodons_addons.description: This perk provides you with complete blueprints for every craftable item, machine, building, and production chain from the Pyanodons mod suite for Factorio, including all its various modules, addons, and expansions. From the simplest component to the most absurdly complex production loop, the knowledge to construct it all resides within your mind. Beyond simple blueprints, you receive just enough scientific and engineering knowledge to somewhat understand how your nightmarishly intricate creations function, allowing you to troubleshoot issues within sprawling multi-step production lines rather than blindly following instructions. You also gain the practical skills needed to utilize, construct, and reliably maintain this brutally complex technology, ensuring your factories continue operating even as they spiral into ever-greater complexity.

repair_turret.name: Repair Turret
repair_turret.description: You gain the ability to construct a tower-like structure that projects energy beams to automatically repair your buildings and machinery, consuming both power and repair kits to do so. This blueprint and its accompanying basic principles are inspired by the Repair Turret mod for Factorio. The device can be built relatively easily, though it will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but difficult for others to replicate or maintain. This perk provides only the fundamental theory and a single specific blueprint - you do not actually understand how the technology works on a deeper level, nor do you know if it would be possible to construct using completely mundane science and engineering without the supernatural advantages this perk provides.

robot_army.name: Robot Army
robot_army.description: Inspired by the mod of the same name, this perk allows you to manufacture and deploy automated robot soldiers to attack your foes and defend your factory. You possess complete blueprints for every craftable item from the mod - including robot chassis, weapon mounts, and support infrastructure. Beyond construction, you also know how to program and command these mechanical legions effectively. You can issue tactical orders, establish patrol routes, coordinate assaults, and manage your robotic forces with the expertise of a seasoned commander.

shield_projector.name: Shield Projector
shield_projector.description: You gain the ability to construct a device that projects an energy shield in an arc: a defensive wall that requires only power to sustain itself. This blueprint and its accompanying basic scientific principles are inspired by the Shield Projector mod for Factorio. The device can be built relatively easily, though it will function as tinkertech: reliable in your hands but difficult for others to replicate or maintain. This perk provides only the fundamental theory and a single specific blueprint - no deeper understanding of energy shielding beyond this particular application.

spidertron_extended.name: Spidertron Extended
spidertron_extended.description: This perk adds a suite of advanced spider-vehicle blueprints to your repertoire: the Spidertron MK2, Spidertron MK3, the Immolator, the Ghost Weaver, and the formidable Major Spidertron. Each represents a significant upgrade over the original: featuring enhanced firing capabilities, larger inventory sizes, expanded equipment grids, built-in radar coverage, superior mobility, and much more. However, this technology functions strangely. If you do not have access to the original Factorio Spidertron as a foundational technology, these advanced variants will be forced into a tinkertech paradigm - reliable in your hands but poorly understood, difficult to maintain, and impossible for others to replicate without your direct involvement. Based on Spidertron Extended mod for Factorio.

actually_additions.name: Actually Additions
actually_additions.description: "Use the Atomic Reconstructor and the Empowerer to turn minerals into powerful crystals that allow the creation of useful machines for processing and sorting items, lasers for wirelessly transporting energy, items, and fluids, renewable oil to generate power, and much more." - You gain the knowledge and ability to construct and utilize all devices, tools, and systems from the Actually Additions mod.

advanced_generators.name: Advanced Generators
advanced_generators.description: This perk provides a mental compendium of blueprints for creating machines and devices from the Advanced Generators mod for Minecraft, along with basic construction skills and deep insight into general energy-generation technology and its applications. More importantly, this perk grants you a fundamental understanding of how to adapt and integrate power systems. You find it significantly easier to tweak and modify various generators you know how to build, and you can devise clever ways to connect machines to power sources. Even when such connections would normally be incompatible. You simply know how to think about these problems and, more often than not, how to solve them.

almost_unified.name: Almost Unified
almost_unified.description: Inspired by the Almost Unified mod for Minecraft, this perk grants you exceptional expertise in the field of material science. You possess a keen intuition and a supernatural advantage when working to substitute materials in your creations with functionally similar alternatives. If you find yourself lacking access to a specific exotic metal or rare component, you can devise special alloys or material equivalents using only the resources currently available to you. These substitutions will perform nearly as well as the original. At least, close enough that only a true expert would notice the difference. Although, there are limitations on how much can stretch thing.

applied_refined_storage.name: Applied Refined Storage
applied_refined_storage.description: You possess all blueprints, theoretical knowledge, and practical skills required to create and utilize concepts from the Applied Energistics and Refined Storage mods, along with their various addons. Your expertise centers on the conversion of matter and energy into digital form for the purposes of storage, transportation, retrieval, and even automated processing - transforming physical resources into data and back again with remarkable efficiency. However, as you venture further from the core themes of these mods and delve deeper into addon content, your understanding becomes progressively more difficult to apply. The further an addon strays from the main storage-and-automation focus, the harder and more vaguely defined your knowledge becomes, making reliable creation and implementation increasingly challenging.

ars_nouveau.name: Ars Nouveau
ars_nouveau.description: "Ars Nouveau is a magic mod inspired by Ars Magicka that allows players to craft their own spells, create magical artifacts, perform rituals, and much more." You receive the degree of magical abilities required to utilize and create items from Ars Nouveau mod and its various addons, along with a comprehensive mental library of basic blueprints, core theories, and the innate talent to progress swiftly along this path of magic.

astral_sorcery.name: Astral Sorcery
astral_sorcery.description: "Astral Sorcery is a magic mod focused around harnessing the powers of starlight and the constellations." You gain the necessary magical abilities to practice the art of Astral Sorcery, including the knowledge required to use and create all items, structures, and enchantments from this mod and its various addons. You receive basic blueprints, a comprehensive understanding of stellar theory, and the innate talent to progress swiftly along this path, allowing you to draw down the power of the stars themselves.

better_dimensions.name: Better Dimensions
better_dimensions.description: You possess the ability to modify portals to the Nether and the End, allowing you to redirect them to their modded counterparts instead. By mixing and matching different combinations of mods - such as Better Nether or Better End - you can extensively customize each portal and the dimension it leads to. However, there are limitations. There is only one version of a dimension for each modified portal decided by the moment you firstly created specific variation of the gates: each version of the dimension can only be generated once. Modifying a portal requires both time and resources, and you must first possess the ability to build vanilla Minecraft portals for this perk to function properly. In addition, you gain extensive and in-depth knowledge of all things related to the mods you wish to use. You are intimately familiar with the materials, structures, creatures, flora, dangers, and useful tricks found within these transformed dimensions, ensuring you are prepared for what awaits.

better_questing.name: Better Questing
better_questing.description: There are many modpacks with some sort of quest system or book. You gain the ability to create personal, soul-bound quest books for individuals. Each person can possess only one such book, and it cannot be destroyed by conventional means, as it is a projection of their inner world. These books contain unique, dynamically updating quests tailored to the owner. Completing quests rewards the individual with thematic prizes based on their accomplishments. However, the nature of both quests and rewards depends heavily on the person: their desires, beliefs, knowledge, and personal journey.

biomancy.name: Biomancy
biomancy.description: Life is the ultimate resource, and now you know how to reshape it. This perk provides you with the blueprints, theoretical knowledge, and inherent magical capacity to build and utilize every device from the Biomancy mod.

blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
blood_magic.description: "Blood Magic is an arcane art practiced by mages who seek to gather vast power through the use of a forbidden material: blood. Though it grants immense power, every action performed with this volatile magic can prove deadly. You have been warned." You gain the necessary magical abilities to practice the art of Blood Magic, including the knowledge required to create and use all devices, rituals, and tools from this mod and its various addons. You receive basic blueprints, a firm grasp of the underlying theories, and the innate talent to progress swiftly along this dangerous but rewarding path. Provided you can survive the cost.

botania.name: Botania
botania.description: You gain access to the magical abilities required to create items and structures from the Botania mod, a tech-inspired magic mod centered around the power of natural flora and mana manipulation. This perk provides you with a basic theoretical foundation, a set of starting blueprints, and the innate capacity to unlock further content through acts of creation, experimentation, and dedicated research. Your progression path includes access to some popular add-ons for the mod, though your understanding becomes progressively more vague and tedious the further an add-on strays from Botania's core themes.

charging_gadgets.name: Charging Gadgets
charging_gadgets.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct a single, deceptively simple machine - the charging station. Despite its unassuming design, this device functions as a full tinkertech apparatus capable of recharging almost any item from Minecraft mods, and with some creative tweaking, it can even be modified to charge other, unrelated devices you may encounter. You do not understand how it works on any fundamental level, and frankly, you are reasonably certain it should not work this well given how simple the design appears. Nevertheless, it provides an easy and reliable solution for keeping your various gadgets powered. Perhaps if you dedicated significant time to researching the device in depth, you might begin to figure out some of the little things that make it tick...

cheap_storage_solutions.name: Cheap Storage Solutions
cheap_storage_solutions.description: Why build a warehouse when you can build a drawer? You now have the know-how and ability to construct containers that defy physics, from simple chests to elaborate drawer systems, all capable of holding stacks upon stacks of items. Some specialize in single item types for efficiency, while others accept everything (and will absolutely become a sorting nightmare if you're not careful). Your repertoire includes designs inspired by Storage Drawers, Sophisticated Backpacks, and Iron Chests, allowing you to experiment with a wide variety of functions. Do note that this technology is essentially tinkertech running at maximum settings - held together by fiat rather than genuine physics. With time and study, you may eventually learn to create truly "bigger on the inside" containers that function without reality-warping assistance, but not using this perk alone.

create.name: Create
create.description: You possess all blueprints, expertise, and practical skills required to build and operate devices inspired by the Create mod for Minecraft, along with several of its most famous addons. Your knowledge centers primarily on mechanical engineering, rotational power, factory automation, and the wonderfully complex "tinker-bullshit". Included addons cover a wide range of themes: Steam 'n' Rails for trains and locomotives; Crafts & Additions for supplementary tools; Big Cannons for artillery; New Age for alternative power sources; Enchantment Industry for automated enchanting; Utilities for miscellaneous gadgets; and others besides. However, exploring addons further removed from the core mechanical theme becomes progressively more difficult - the more distant an addon's focus from the main Create experience, the harder and more vaguely defined your knowledge becomes, requiring greater time and effort to master, making your creations less reliable.

dark_utilities.name: Dark Utilities
dark_utilities.description: "The Dark Utilities mod adds many new items and blocks that expand upon the vanilla game. This mod aims to be useful in a wide range of circumstances while also adding fun and interesting mechanics." You gain the knowledge and ability to construct all devices, machines, and items from the Dark Utilities mod, along with a complete understanding of how to use them effectively. Furthermore, you find this technology exceptionally intuitive to tinker with, allowing you to adapt, modify, and integrate it with other systems with surprising ease.

desertification_infection.name: Desertification 'Infection'
desertification_infection.description: This perk allows you to generate the Infectious Desert biome from the Minecraft Desertification mod, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into this hostile landscape. The biome will spread slowly outward from the initial point of impact after generation using sand, though the speed and effectiveness of this spread depend heavily on the nature of the surrounding environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the infection. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk also grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the nature, contents, and unique properties of the Infectious Desert biome, including any resources, creatures, or phenomena found within and how to take advantage of them.

dis-enchanting.name: Dis-Enchanting
dis-enchanting.description: You possess the knowledge to design, build, and operate dis-enchantment machinery. This allows you to safely extract and recover enchantments from items and enchanted books, preserving them for later use on new equipment. This knowledge is based on the eponymous mod and is optimized for the runic and symbolic enchantment systems common to Minecraft and closely related types of enchanting. It is basically useless for other situations.

doggy_talents_next.name: Doggy Talents Next
doggy_talents_next.description: "This mod aims to create harmony between dogs and the player throughout the game. Imagine playing a piano concerto, you as the pianist and the dogs as the orchestra. When the two sounds are played together, they create harmony - something our ears love. Thus, the orchestra does not overwhelm but empowers the pianist. The mod is and will be designed along this principle: the dogs should accompany the player well without becoming overpowered. However, when the situation demands it, sufficient abilities should be granted to them - but they must work to achieve those abilities, and you, the responsible owner, should help them." You possess a special talent for bringing the content of Doggy Talents Next mod into reality. You have a natural affinity for bonding with and training canine companions, unlocking their hidden potential and teaching them a wide variety of useful talents and abilities. Your dogs will accompany you faithfully, growing stronger through shared effort.

doing_cool_stuff_with_pressurised_air.name: Doing Cool Stuff With Pressurised Air
doing_cool_stuff_with_pressurised_air.description: You gain access to mental blueprints for all craftable items from the PneumaticCraft mod, along with significant innate talent for understanding pneumatic technology and principles as a whole. While this perk provides you with a comprehensive education in pneumatic systems, their theoretical underpinnings, and their potential applied uses, it does not grant much in the way of actual practical skill - you know how things should work in principle, but developing the hands-on expertise to build and operate them reliably will require practice and experience.

draconic_evolution.name: Draconic Evolution
draconic_evolution.description: This perk grants you the knowledge, complete blueprints for all craftable items, and degree of practical skills required to create and utilize the powerful technologies found in the Draconic Evolution mod. Your expertise spans the full spectrum of this magitech progression system. Be warned: this is high-end magitech creation capability, and it is extraordinarily resource-intensive. The reactors alone can level mountains if they malfunction, and the weapons... Well, let's just say you should be very certain about what you're aiming at. Take proper precautions, follow safety protocols, and for the love of all that is holy, do not accidentally explode yourself and your neighbors.

ender_io.name: Ender IO
ender_io.description: This perk provides you with mental compendium of complete blueprints for every craftable item from the Ender IO Minecraft mod, as well as the foundational theory and practical skills needed to operate its devices.

ensorcellation.name: Ensorcellation
ensorcellation.description: You gain the ability to practice the magical enchantment art found in the Ensorcellation mod, along with natural talent in this craft and a scholarly intuition for applying enchanted items in both conventional and creative ways. However, if you do not have access to vanilla Minecraft enchanting, your creations will inevitably function as tinkertech (unreliable, difficult to replicate, or prone to malfunction) and your knowledge of the field will have significant gaps. You can still create enchanted items, but your work will be limited by these constraints until you acquire a proper foundation in enchanting.

evilcraft.name: EvilCraft
evilcraft.description: The path of blood and vengeance calls. This perk grants you supernatural capabilities, basic theoretical knowledge, and the essential blueprints needed to harness the dark arts inspired by the EvilCraft mod. You receive one Dark Gem at no additional cost, and you know the ritual required to sacrifice it - transforming the gem into a special book that will guide you further down the path of blood magic and mechanical mayhem.

ex_nihilo.name: Ex Nihilo
ex_nihilo.description: You gain the ability to create anomalous tools inspired by the Ex Nihilo Minecraft mod and its various addons. These seemingly simple machines and tools allow you to produce resources literally from nothing. Not in great quantity, and with many caveats, but enough to scrape together essential materials even in the most barren wastelands where only scraps and dirt are available.

extended_crafting.name: Extended Crafting
extended_crafting.description: "Extended Crafting adds more ways to craft items, more items to craft with, and more utilities for crafting. The mod doesn't do much on its own and is intended to be configured heavily. All recipes and settings should be changed to fit the progression of the modpack it's in and how the modpack developer wants it to be used." This perk grants you great knowledge of extended crafting methodologies, along with a supernatural advantage when designing and applying modifications to any blueprint you already possess. It also provides the base blueprints needed to construct the fundamental machinery from the mod itself. Essentially, this perk allows you to fundamentally change how you craft things: discovering new approaches, combining existing knowledge in novel ways, and creating entirely new production methods using only the resources and recipes you already have at your disposal. You are good at finding out how to create same things in different ways.

extensive_automated_mapping.name: Extensive Automated Mapping
extensive_automated_mapping.description: This mental ability combines the core functions of several popular minimap mods, such as Xaero's Minimap and JourneyMap, into a single convenient power. You possess a fully customizable mental map that automatically updates as you explore, detecting and categorizing creatures, players, and points of interest in your vicinity. The map also provides useful information such as the current time, your coordinates, and other environmental details. You can create and manage waypoints to mark important locations, though this perk does not grant any fast travel functionality - you still need to reach those destinations on your own.

extreme_reactors.name: Extreme Reactors
extreme_reactors.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct powerful reactors to harness the power of the atom. You also gain the expertise needed to build mighty turbines that convert steam into usable energy. Your knowledge includes complete blueprints, a deep understanding of reactor mechanics, extensive practical expertise in maintenance and proper operation, and the required theoretical background to keep your systems running safely and efficiently. While your expertise focuses specifically on these particular reactor designs, you understand them inside and out.

forestry.name: Forestry
forestry.description: You gain access to the full breadth of content inspired by the Forestry mod for Minecraft and its various addons. You possess the capability to create, use, and even modify all devices, machines, and systems found within - including apiaries, multifarms, greenhouses, and tree breeding setups. Unlike some other perks that grant extensive theoretical knowledge, this perk focuses on pure capability. You may not always understand the underlying principles of why something works, but you can make it work regardless. For example, it includes the skills of a supernatural beekeeper - allowing you to breed, crossbreed, and mutate bees in ways that defy conventional biology, producing remarkable hybrids with extraordinary properties.

fungal_infection.name: Fungal Infection
fungal_infection.description: This perk allows you to deploy an active Fungal Infection bioweapon from the Fungal Infection: Spore Minecraft mod. Upon activation, the infection will take root in the surrounding area and begin spreading slowly outward over time. The speed and effectiveness of this spread depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the fungal growth. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge about the Fungal Infection: its nature, properties, life cycle, and contents. Additionally, you are rendered permanently immune to the infection and any harmful status effects it might inflict upon you.

immersive_engineering.name: Immersive Engineering
immersive_engineering.description: You possess access to blueprints for all craftable items, along with the expertise required to create and operate machines and devices from the Immersive Engineering mod and its various popular add-ons. This perk also provides you with the equivalent of a high-end professional education in engineering by 20th-century standards, giving you a solid foundation in real-world mechanical and electrical principles that complements your modded knowledge. However, your understanding of add-on content becomes progressively more vague the further it strays from the core themes and aesthetic of the original Immersive Engineering mod - familiar territory remains clear, but distant branches require greater effort and intuition to navigate reliably.

immersive_portals.name: Immersive Portals
immersive_portals.description: You possess the power to manipulate and create portals, cut doors into other accessible dimensions, and modify existing portals with changes being stable and permanent, if you wish so. This ability is inspired by the Immersive Portals mod for Minecraft, granting you everything the mod allows and a bit more. You gain access to additional possibilities and a deeper understanding of the implications of carving space in this way. However, be cautious. While the power provides some intuition and feedback, it is not foolproof. Mistakes can have consequences.

improvable_skills.name: Improvable Skills
improvable_skills.description: You gain access to the skill tree system from the Improvable Skills mod for Minecraft. By living through unique, interesting, or formative experiences, you earn points that can be used to unlock new effects, passive bonuses, and special abilities within the tree. What qualifies as a "suitable experience" scales with your current abilities and past experiences, ensuring that you must continually seek out new challenges and growth opportunities to earn further progression. As a consolidation prize, you receive one free skill point immediately upon purchasing this perk, and thereafter, you will automatically gain one random, accessible skill from the tree each month.

industrial_craft.name: Industrial Craft
industrial_craft.description: The spark of industry ignites within you. This perk provides the blueprints, theoretical knowledge, and fundamental skills needed to build and operate machines from Industrial Craft, its many versions, and its extensive addons. Base technology is intuitive and clear: cables, generators, and machines all behave as expected. But venture into the more exotic addons, and things start to get messy. Documentation becomes sparse, interactions grow unpredictable, and you'll find yourself relying more on trial and error than clean engineering.

iron_jetpacks.name: Iron Jetpacks
iron_jetpacks.description: Why walk when you can fly? This perk grants you the knowledge to construct and operate every device from the Iron Jetpacks mod with expert skill. These are tinkertech through and through - strap one on, fire it up and soar. They work reliably, but you have no actual theory or reasonable explanation for how they function.

its_gold_in_here.name: It's Gold in Here!
its_gold_in_here.description: When exploring new places in person, you have a chance to find unique materials and resources from the Mythic Metals and Gobber mods for Minecraft - even if it doesn't make much sense for them to be there, and even though they definitely weren't there before you explored the area. This effect only triggers in locations you explore personally, and its strength is inversely proportional to your prior knowledge of the area: the more you already know about a location before setting foot there, the less effective this perk becomes. You may toggle this effect on or off at will, or configure it to work partially - causing some materials to appear while others do not. Any resources generated will only appear in places similar to their typical generation conditions from their source mods. This perk may be purchased multiple times. Each additional purchase (discounted to 200 CP) allows you to include materials from one other Minecraft mod you currently possess a perk for. If you have no other mod perks, you may instead choose to have this perk select a random source mod with material or resource content for you from all Minecraft mods list.

jewelry_and_baubles.name: Jewelry and Baubles
jewelry_and_baubles.description: You become a master jeweler of exceptional skill, gifted with the special ability to create a wide variety of magical jewelry and baubles and to utilize them effectively. This perk encompasses the full content from several mods, including Iron's Gems 'n Jewelry, Jewelry (RPG Series), and Magical Jewelry, along with all their respective addons and expansions. You understand the intricate art of gemcutting, precious metalworking, and enchanting jewelry with potent magical effects.

just_enough_items.name: Just Enough Items
just_enough_items.description: This thinker power grants you the ability to obtain a mental blueprint for crafting any object you are holding in your hands or currently examining. It provides the simplest, most straightforward version of the recipe first, drawing upon your existing perks and knowledge to generate a feasible method. More complex items require additional time to analyze, and in some cases, the power may fail to provide a blueprint if the object cannot be reasonably recreated with the abilities you currently possess. When successfully crafting an item using one of these blueprints, you may occasionally discover new variations or improved versions of the original design - particularly if you are lucky or if the power learns something significant during the process. This perk is exceptionally useful for reverse engineering technology, magic items, or any intriguing object you happen to come across.

large_ore_deposits.name: Large Ore Deposits
large_ore_deposits.description: This perk grants you the power to perform a special ritual that creates a substantial ore deposit beneath your current location. By sacrificing a targeted material as a "seed," along with several other components determined by the primary material, you can force the generation of a large underground vein containing raw ore inspired by the sacrificed seed. The more esoteric, rare, or unique the material you wish to duplicate, the more elaborate, complex, and costly the ritual becomes - requiring rarer catalysts, more precise conditions, or additional steps. The ritual can only be performed once every 24 hours, and it carries a risk of failure if you are underprepared, interrupt the procedure, or make a mistake in its execution.

mekanism.name: Mekanism
mekanism.description: You possess access to blueprints for all craftable items, a comprehensive theoretical foundation, and the basic skills necessary to construct machines and devices from the Mekanism mod, along with its various popular add-ons. This perk encompasses the full scope of Mekanism's core modules: Additions (miscellaneous gadgets and decoration), Generators (power production systems), and Tools (equipment and armor). However, as you venture further from the main theme of the base mod and deeper into add-on content, your understanding becomes progressively more limited and less straightforward - the further an add-on strays from Mekanism's core focus, the more difficult and unreliable your ability to comprehend and create its content becomes.

mining_dimension.name: Mining Dimension
mining_dimension.description: You gain the ability to create a mystical portal that leads to a personal mining dimension, inspired by Aroma1997's Dimensional World mod for Minecraft. The contents, resources, and terrain of this dimension are permanently set at the moment of the portal's creation, based entirely on the perks and abilities you possess at that time. Once the dimension is actualized, acquiring new perks after this point will not alter its contents. However, this perk may be purchased multiple times. Subsequent purchases are discounted to 350 CP and allow you to create an additional, separate dimension, each with its own unique contents based on your perk loadout at the time of its creation.

mining_gadgets.name: Mining Gadgets
mining_gadgets.description: "Sometimes you want a quick change of pace when it comes to mining. Pickaxes. Drills. Bores. Robots. Quarries. These are all great options. Now you can use lasers too if you want." You gain the blueprints needed to craft a variety of mining tools inspired by the Mining Gadgets mod, along with the practical skill to use them effectively. You can easily go full tinkertech with this perk, if you want to save resources and time.

modded_ores.name: Modded Ores
modded_ores.description: You gain the ability to infuse any landscape with Minecraft-style ore generation - once per purchase of this perk. When activated, the effect targets a radius of up to one thousand chunks (approximately 1,600 meters) around your current location. Within this area, new ores will generate underground, drawn from a single mod of your choice for which you possess the corresponding perk. The ores spawned by this effect possess all the unique properties, behaviors, and uses inspired by their source mod, allowing you to introduce new resources into worlds that previously lacked them. You may hold this activation indefinitely, waiting until you find the perfect location and perk before committing the effect. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional roll stockpiling another activation for later use. At the moment of casting, you decide which mod's ores will generate. Subsequent purchases after the first are discounted to 350 CP. This perk can be discarded and rerolled for free.

modular_force_field_systems.name: Modular Force Field Systems
modular_force_field_systems.description: You gain access to blueprints and the practical skills needed to create, use, and maintain a variety of devices from the Modular Force Field Systems mod for Minecraft. These force fields can be constructed relatively cheaply if you embrace a tinkertech approach. However, your knowledge is almost entirely practical - you have little to no understanding of how these devices function on a fundamental level.

modular_machinery.name: Modular Machinery
modular_machinery.description: "A modpack-maker's toolset for creating custom, massive, unique, and complex machines and recipes from scratch." This perk grants you extensive knowledge of modular machine design methodology, along with a supernatural advantage when designing and building modular modifications for any creation you already know how to make. Heavily inspired by the mod of the same name, this ability allows you to construct elaborate, multi-block industrial systems with interchangeable components, tailoring each machine to perform exactly the task you need.

mystical_agriculture.name: Mystical Agriculture
mystical_agriculture.description: You gain the supernatural ability to craft and cultivate magical plants that produce a wide variety of resources, drawing from the Mystical Agriculture mod and its various add-ons. Your mystical crops can yield everything from basic Minecraft materials to resources from other mods, allowing you to grow what would otherwise need to be mined or crafted. You possess a great natural talent for gardening and a keen intuitive understanding of magical flora, enabling you to nurture your crops effectively and expand your agricultural operations with confidence.

ore_generation.name: Ore Generation
ore_generation.description: You gain the ability to trigger a single, massive burst of Minecraft-style ore generation in any landscape you choose. Upon activation, ores ranging from coal and iron to redstone and amethyst geodes will spawn throughout the underground in a radius of one thousand chunks (roughly 1,600 meters) around you. All generated ores possess their unique properties as inspired by their source game. You may hold this perk's activation charge indefinitely, allowing you to wait until you find the perfect location to use it. This perk can be purchased multiple times, stockpiling additional activations for later use. Each purchase after the first is discounted to 200 CP.

oritech.name: Oritech
oritech.description: You gain access to blueprints for all craftable items, along with the methodologies and scientific knowledge required to create, maintain, and operate devices from the Oritech mod for Minecraft. You also become particularly good at applying stylistics of this mod machines yo your other creations as cosmetic feature.

potion_rings.name: Potion Rings
potion_rings.description: "This is a really simple mod, which adds rings that, when equipped in a baubles slot, provide a permanent potion effect. Wearing two of the same ring upgrades that effect to level two." You gain the capability to create and enchant rings that grant continuous potion effects while worn. This crafting method specializes in Minecraft-style potions and works best with vanilla effects - producing stable, reliable rings with predictable results. Wearing two identical rings will upgrade the granted effect to its second level. However, this perk has limitations. Potions from other sources will generally not work with this enchanting method, and the rare few that do prove compatible may cause dangerous failures or unpredictable side effects during the creation process. Additionally, this perk does not grant you any ability or skill to brew potions themselves; it only enables you to embed existing potion effects into rings. You must obtain your potions elsewhere.

projecte.name: ProjectE
projecte.description: You now possess the knowledge and ability to create and utilize a set of supernatural tools and devices capable of exchanging one material for another. This system is built upon the fundamental concept of EMC (Energy-Matter Currency) - a value assigned to every item and block that represents its intrinsic energy cost or worth. With this power, you can collect, store, transfer, and convert EMC, allowing you to duplicate existing items or transmute materials into entirely different substances. You gain a complete understanding of how to construct and operate all devices related to this alchemical system of ProjectE Minecraft mod.

psi_technology.name: Psi Technology
psi_technology.description: "Psi is a magical tech spell programming mod inspired by Mahouka Kokou no Rettousei. Don't worry if that doesn't make any sense." You gain the ability to utilize all devices from the Psi Technology mod, along with complete blueprints for every craftable item. More importantly, you receive an extensive theoretical foundation in the principles of psionic energy manipulation and spell programming, allowing you to understand why your creations work, not just how to build them. You also possess a natural talent for wielding this unique form of magical technology, enabling you to craft complex spell programs and integrate psionic devices into your existing arsenals with creativity and precision.

rftools_dimensions.name: RFTools Dimensions
rftools_dimensions.description: This perk grants you the blueprints and knowledge to construct the dimension-building machines of RFTools Dimensions mod. Yes, they are absurdly energy-hungry and tedious to program. Yes, they require constant maintenance and careful monitoring. But with enough patience and power, you can shape new realities to your whims - whether that means an ocean of liquid gold, an infinite field of giant truffles, or something far stranger.

scape_and_run_parasites.name: Scape and Run: Parasites
scape_and_run_parasites.description: This perk allows you to generate a Parasite-Infected Biome from the Scape and Run: Parasites Minecraft mod, transforming the area within a few tens of meters around you into a hostile, corrupted landscape. Once established, the infection will spread outward using mechanics inspired by the mod: expanding through organic matter, corrupting native life, and adapting to local conditions. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge about the Parasites: their nature, evolution, behavior, and the corrupted contents of the biome. Additionally, you are rendered permanently immune to the infection and any harmful status effects the Parasites might inflict upon you.

sculk_horde.name: Sculk Horde
sculk_horde.description: This perk allows you to spawn an active Ancient Sculk Node with an awakening Gravemind from the Sculk Horde Minecraft mod. Upon activation, the node will begin generating and spreading the Sculk ecosystem throughout the surrounding area, slowly expanding outward over time. The speed and effectiveness of this spread depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the infection. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge about the Sculk Ecosystem: its nature, properties, and contents. Additionally, you are rendered permanently immune to the infection and any harmful status effects the Sculk Horde might inflict upon you.

silent_gear.name: Silent Gear
silent_gear.description: "This mod focuses on tools, weapons, and armor (collectively called 'gear'). Recipes are modular, down to each individual piece used in crafting. Possible combinations for each gear type are practically unlimited." You possess the ability to create the full range of modular gear from the Silent Gear mod and its various addons. This crafting ability is enhanced by a supernatural component, allowing you to intuitively understand material properties, predict optimal part combinations, and forge equipment that exceeds normal expectations. You can mix and match components endlessly, discovering unique synergies and crafting gear perfectly suited to any task.

simple_generators.name: Simple Generators
simple_generators.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct the various power-generating machines from the Simple Generators mod for Minecraft. As the name suggests, these devices produce energy, but they function largely as tinkertech, reliable only in your own hands. You gain exceptional skill and a supernatural advantage specifically when working with generators from this perk: building them, maintaining them, integrating them into systems, and keeping them operational. Outside of this narrow focus, your expertise does not translate. However, the perk does still provide you with some useful and unique theoretical knowledge about energy unorthodox generation solutions that can be applied more broadly. Even if the practical applications remain a bit elusive.

simply_skills.name: Simply Skills
simply_skills.description: You gain access to the skill tree system from the Simply Skills mod for Minecraft. By participating in challenging fights and experiencing unique or interesting adventures, you earn points that can be used to unlock new effects, passive bonuses, and special abilities within the tree. What qualifies as a "good fight" or a "suitable experience" scales with your current abilities and past experiences, ensuring that you must continually push your limits to earn further progression. As a consolidation prize, you receive one free skill point immediately upon purchasing this perk, and thereafter, you will automatically gain one random, accessible skill from the tree each month.

simply_swords.name: Simply Swords
simply_swords.description: You gain exceptional smithing skills focused specifically on the creation of weapons and items from the Simply Swords mod for Minecraft. You can craft every blade, hilt, and unique weapon featured in the mod with masterful precision. Additionally, you possess a natural talent for wielding all types of weapons found in the Simply Swords mod (including unique variants) though this talent manifests only as raw affinity, not as actual combat skills.
