You will find these weapons comfortable and intuitive in your hands, but you must still train and practice to use them effectively in battle.

spartan_weaponry.name: Spartan Weaponry
spartan_weaponry.description: You gain access to all blueprints and crafting recipes from the Spartan Weaponry and Spartan Shields Minecraft mods. You gain the knowledge and skill required to forge this expanded arsenal - everything from pikes and rapiers to battleaxes, javelins, and reinforced shields. Beyond mere crafting, you receive the equivalent of extensive combat training with each weapon type, allowing you to wield them with an above-average degree of finesse right from the start. You understand the strengths and weaknesses of each weapon, proper techniques for different combat scenarios, and how to maintain your gear effectively. Furthermore, you possess great natural talent for advancing these skills further, enabling you to progress toward true mastery with continued practice and experience far more quickly than most.

tasty-tasty_addon.name: Tasty-Tasty Addon!
tasty-tasty_addon.description: You are now a skilled culinary artist, possessing a complete mental compendium of every recipe, blueprint, and design from popular food and farming mods such as Farmer's Delight, Cooking for Blockheads, Pam's HarvestCraft, and all their various addons and expansions. In addition to your cooking knowledge, you have been granted the fundamental skills required to source, grow, or gather any ingredient you might need, ensuring you can always prepare a delicious meal.

tempad.name: Tempad
tempad.description: This perk provides you with the blueprints for every craftable item from the Tempad mod, as well as the basic theory and hands-on skills required to use them. With this knowledge, you can create personal portal devices that let you and your companions blink across vast distances in an instant - provided you're staying within the same world, at least for now.

terrafirmacraft.name: TerraFirmaCraft
terrafirmacraft.description: You gain the comprehensive knowledge and practical skills needed to progress through the entire tech tree from the TerraFirmaCraft mod for Minecraft and its various addons. Starting with nothing but the raw materials nature provides, you can knap stone tools, process ores, craft advanced machinery, and gradually build the foundations of a thriving civilization from scratch.

tetra.name: Tetra
tetra.description: You gain access to all the necessary skills and knowledge to modify tools and weapons in the style of the Tetra mod. From simple hammers to intricate blades, you can swap components, enhance performance, and tailor every detail to your needs. With creativity, you can even apply this modular crafting system to items beyond the original scope of the mod.

thaumcraft.name: Thaumcraft
thaumcraft.description: The path of the thaumaturge opens before you. This perk grants you the power to wield the magic of Thaumcraft (including its various versions and famous addons), along with the ability to research its mysteries with exceptional speed and efficiency. Your knowledge of the arcane also allows you, with some ingenuity, to awaken the ability to use this magic in others later.

the_aether.name: The Aether
the_aether.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct a functional portal to the Aether - a luminous floating dimension inspired by the classic Aether mod for Minecraft - even if your current world does not naturally connect to this realm. To build the portal, you will need glowstone or a sufficiently close equivalent material, arranged in the proper frame configuration and activated with water. You have basic theoretical understanding behind working of the portal. You also possess basic survival knowledge about the Aether: an understanding of the native materials you may encounter, awareness of points of interest such as dungeons or structures, and familiarity with the general landscape and biomes of floating islands. Additionally, you gain a remarkable adaptability to high altitudes, allowing you to navigate the sky realms without the disorientation or physical strain that might normally accompany such extreme heights.

the_twilight_forest.name: The Twilight Forest
the_twilight_forest.description: You gain the ability to create a portal that leads to a newly generated Twilight Forest dimension, inspired by the Minecraft mod of the same name. This dimension includes all content from the original mod and its various addons. You possess general knowledge of its important aspects: the dangers that lurk within, useful materials to be found, the unique flora and fauna, and the mystical laws that govern this enchanted realm.

the_undergarden.name: The Undergarden
the_undergarden.description: This perk grants you the knowledge to craft the key - a special tool that, when used correctly, activates a portal to the Undergarden. Upon arrival, you will find a newly generated dimension filled with strange flora, eerie creatures, and untold mysteries. You are granted encyclopedic knowledge of this realm and the fundamental survival skills to navigate its dangers. Most importantly, you are completely immune to any diseases, blights, or contaminants that fester within this subterranean world.

thermal_expansion.name: Thermal Expansion
thermal_expansion.description: This perk grants you access to all blueprints, expertise, and practical skills required to create and operate machines from the Thermal Expansion mod for Minecraft. Your knowledge encompasses all six main modules of the mod: Foundation (base components and materials), Cultivation (farming and botany), Dynamics (item and fluid transport), Innovation (advanced gadgets), Integration (cross-mod compatibility), and Locomotion (movable structures and carts). Additionally, you have access to various famous addons that expand upon the Thermal series. However, exploring these addon branches becomes progressively more difficult - the further you venture from the core theme of the base mod, the harder and more vaguely defined your knowledge becomes, requiring significantly more time and effort to master, with results that can be rather tedious to achieve and less reliable.

theurgy.name: Theurgy
theurgy.description: You gain the knowledge and ability to utilize the mechanics of the Minecraft mod Theurgy and its various addons. This includes the skill to create all machines, devices, materials, and mystical apparatuses featured in the mod, allowing you to practice the art of alchemical transformation, mineral purification, and essence manipulation with confidence and precision.

tinkers_construct.name: Tinker's Construct
tinkers_construct.description: You gain the necessary knowledge, blueprints for all craftable items, skills and abilities to produce tools, weapons, and machines from the Tinker's Construct mod, along with its various add-ons and extensions. This power is partly magical in nature, allowing you to draw out unique and exotic functionalities from even seemingly mundane materials through the art of tool forging and material modification. Your understanding of material properties runs deep enough that you may eventually discover new properties and combinations not present in the original mod or its add-ons - pushing the boundaries of what can be crafted through experimentation and creative tinkering.

vein_mining.name: Vein Mining
vein_mining.description: This striker power, inspired by various popular mining mods, allows you to harvest extensive quantities of connected or similar material in a single action. By activating this ability while mining a target material/structure - such as starting to chop down a tree - the effect propagates through all connected materials of the same type, rapidly disassembling the entire structure into its base materials. A single swing can fell an entire forest giant or clear a massive ore vein with startling efficiency. However, this convenience comes with significant limitations. You require the appropriate tool for each material type (an axe for wood, a pickaxe for stone, etc.), and the process accelerates tool wear proportionally to the quantity of material harvested. Tools will break faster, and any fuel or energy sources will be consumed at an increased rate. The ability also places additional strain on your body, making you hungrier much faster than normal exertion would. Complex structures built from multiple different material types cannot be reliably broken down with vein mining, and there are hard size limits on how large a single excavation can be. If you possess a personal inventory or pocket dimension, all mined resources will be automatically deposited there; otherwise, they will be neatly piled in stacks near your location.

waystones.name: Waystones
waystones.description: This perk grants you the ability to craft and enchant waystone pillars, along with all associated accessories needed to utilize them. Once activated, these waystones serve as fixed teleportation points that you can return to through various means - using a Warp Scroll, a rechargeable Warp Stone, or by hopping directly from one waystone to another. You possess the necessary skills and practical abilities to create these items and make them functional, though you do not actually understand the underlying magical or mechanical principles that make them work. You can build them, but explaining how they function is beyond your current knowledge.

what_are_we_looking_at.name: What Are We Looking At
what_are_we_looking_at.description: This thinker power grants you basic but useful information about anything you directly look at. When focusing on a creature, object, or material, you receive short, practical details such as its health, common name, type, charge level and - in the case of materials - the minimum tool level required to harvest it effectively. The information provided is surface-level and utilitarian, offering quick insights to aid in navigation, combat, and resource gathering, but it does not reveal anything deep, hidden, or complex about the target.

alpha_genes.name: Alpha Genes
alpha_genes.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of every genetic sequence, xenotype, and gene variant introduced in the Alpha Genes mod for RimWorld. This knowledge includes detailed instructions on how to extract, synthesize, stabilize, and implant these genes effectively. However, this perk grants only the knowledge - it does not provide the laboratory equipment, sophisticated machinery, or practical skills required to perform the genetic manipulation itself. To make use of these blueprints, you must possess the necessary tools and expertise, such as the Biotech perk from a RimWorld or similar gene-engineering capabilities from another setting. Without those, this compendium remains purely theoretical.

auto_dissector.name: Auto Dissector
auto_dissector.description: "An automated surgical device has been added to your arsenal. This machine can precisely remove diseased organs, detach bionic implants you deem unnecessary, or (for those with less ethical inclinations) process prisoners efficiently for bulk extraction of desired body parts." You receive one fully functional Auto Dissector from the mod of the same name. This sophisticated piece of medical machinery handles delicate surgical extraction with robotic precision, minimizing tissue damage and maximizing organ viability. Whether you need to harvest implants from traitors, remove cancerous organs for replacement, or simply process a prison population for valuable components, this machine does the job quickly and cleanly. Along with the unit itself, you receive a thick, detailed technical manual containing comprehensive instructions on how to operate the machine, perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot common issues, and (with sufficient study) construct additional units from scratch. Good luck figuring it out! (The machine's ethical subroutines are optional. Your conscience is your own.)

gene_fabrication.name: Gene Fabrication
gene_fabrication.description: "Are you tired of spending hours grinding quests, extracting prisoners, and trading across the galaxy just to find one specific gene? When your mod list includes hundreds of new xenotypes and genetic variants, is it really worth losing your sanity over the grind? Now there is a solution." With the Gene Fabrication bench, you can synthesize any gene you have encountered or possess a sample of, eliminating the need for endless searching and random chance. You receive one fully functional Gene Fabrication bench from the mod of the same name, along with a thick, detailed technical manual. This manual contains comprehensive instructions on how to operate the machine, perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot common issues, and (with sufficient study) construct additional units from scratch. Good luck figuring it out! (The knowledge is in the manual. Probably. You did read the manual, right?)

glittertech_expansion.name: Glittertech Expansion
glittertech_expansion.description: The pinnacle of glitterworld science is now within your reach. You gain the ability to manufacture a wide array of advanced devices from the Glittertech Expansion mod for RimWorld. This perk provides you with a basic understanding of the underlying principles behind this technology. From luxury goods to high-performance equipment, the marvels of glitterworld engineering are yours to command.

hacking_expansion.name: Hacking Expansion
hacking_expansion.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every device, tool, and system introduced in the Hacking Expansion mod for RimWorld. This knowledge encompasses everything from cryptographic analyzers and hacking tools to mainframe interfaces and security override modules. Unlike mere theoretical understanding, this perk also grants you the practical skills and technical expertise required to actually construct, deploy, and operate these devices effectively. You know how to interface with various computer systems, bypass security protocols, and utilize your crafted tools to their fullest potential.

integrated_implants.name: Integrated Implants
integrated_implants.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of every cybernetic implant, bionic prosthetic, and neural interface introduced in the Integrated Implants mod for RimWorld. This knowledge includes detailed schematics, component lists, and precise surgical instructions for fabricating and installing each augmentation effectively. Unlike purely theoretical knowledge, this perk also grants you the practical skills and technical expertise required to perform the delicate work of implant construction and surgical implantation. Your hands know the techniques, your eyes recognize the proper tolerances, and your mind understands the biological and cybernetic principles at play. However, knowledge and skill are worthless without the proper tools. This perk provides no equipment, no fabrication benches, no surgical tools, and no sterile facilities or skills to manufacture them. To actually produce and install these implants, you must acquire the necessary machinery and medical equipment through other means.

lost_factory_mechanoids.name: Lost Factory Mechanoids
lost_factory_mechanoids.description: You possess the knowledge and capability to establish a small-scale production facility dedicated to crafting the advanced machines and devices featured in the Lost Factory Mechanoids and Mechanoid Upgrades mods for RimWorld. This perk provides you with a comprehensive mental compendium of technical knowledge, granting you a perfect understanding of the schematics, construction processes, and underlying principles for all items within these mods. You know how to build, maintain, and repair everything from autonomous worker drones to formidable combat mechanoids and their powerful upgrades.

rimsenal_pack.name: Rimsenal Pack
rimsenal_pack.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for items, structures, and even some creatures from the Rimsenal Pack of mods for RimWorld. This includes the full range of faction-specific weapons, armors, apparel, turrets, production facilities, and unique biological entities introduced across the Rimsenal series. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items using available materials. Additionally, you gain an incredible natural talent for employing weapons for their intended purpose, allowing you to wield even unfamiliar firearms and armaments with surprising effectiveness. This perk provides only basic background scientific knowledge. Without deeper foundational understanding, your creations will easily default to tinkertech status: reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and difficult for others to replicate or maintain.

vanilla_furniture_expanded.name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded
vanilla_furniture_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Furniture Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes all variants of production benches, decorative furnishings, storage solutions, and specialized structures introduced across the entire furniture expansion suite. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively construct and utilize these items using available materials.

vanilla_genetics_expanded.name: Vanilla Genetics Expanded
vanilla_genetics_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Genetics Expanded mod for RimWorld. This includes genetic labs, gene extractors, mutagens, and all equipment needed for animal hybridization and genetic manipulation. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items. However, this perk provides no in-depth scientific knowledge. If you do not also possess the Biotech perk from the RimWorld category, your genetic creations will function as tinkertech - reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and nearly impossible for others to replicate or maintain.

vanilla_vehicles_expande.name: Vanilla Vehicles Expande
vanilla_vehicles_expande.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Vehicles Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes all vehicle chassis, engines, weapon mounts, utility modules, and specialized transport options across the entire expanded vehicle lineup. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively construct, maintain, and operate these vehicles. Additionally, you gain a significant degree of natural talent for any vehicle-related mechanical fields (including repair, customization, and performance optimization) allowing you to coax maximum capability from any wheeled or tracked conveyance.

vanilla_weapons_expanded.name: Vanilla Weapons Expanded
vanilla_weapons_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable weapon from the Vanilla Weapons Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes the full range of ballistic firearms, melee armaments, grenades, heavy weapons, and specialized munitions introduced across the entire expanded arsenal. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills and working knowledge needed to effectively utilize, maintain, and create these weapons using available materials and facilities.

calamity_expansion.name: Calamity Expansion
calamity_expansion.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Calamity mod and its various addons for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including legendary effects, unique abilities, and devastating power, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Calamity item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and god-slaying properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Redemption mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including holy abilities, corrupted powers, and unique mechanical functions, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Redemption item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and redemption-forged properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

spirit_expansion.name: Spirit Expansion
spirit_expansion.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the various versions of the Spirit mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including ethereal abilities, spirit-infused powers, and unique class mechanics, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Spirit mod item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech - unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and spiritual essence of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical properties from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

starlight_river.name: Starlight River
starlight_river.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Starlight River mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including unique effects, celestial abilities, and luminous qualities, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Starlight River item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and starlight-infused properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

thorium.name: Thorium
thorium.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Thorium mod for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including class-defining abilities, unique set bonuses, and powerful effects, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Thorium item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and thorium-infused properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

aspects_and_essences.name: Aspects and Essences
aspects_and_essences.description: This Tinker ability is all about working with the Essence and Aspects of physical objects and energy. You can build tools to decipher what conceptual components the targeted phenomenon contains, then create a device or method to extract a few highly expressed aspects from the object in the form of essences, and eventually figure out how to apply this essence to other objects. It is very research-intensive and requires one to focus on specific objects, aspects, and use cases each time. However, it allows you to create objects with bizarre properties using relatively mundane items as a source of essence. You can detect, isolate, extract, and eventually apply something like the 'toxicity' aspect from radiation to another device or material. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

blackbox_principles.name: Blackbox Principles
blackbox_principles.description: You can apply principles of tinkertech blackboxing to mundane devices and your other creations. You have full control over the degree of blackboxing used and its nature. It can involve simple methods to make your creations resistant to reverse engineering and research by others, or a complete tinkertech-tier blackbox, making the inner workings of the machine practically incomprehensible and impossible for outside observers. However, you need to have some sort of target to apply this tinker power. It can work with a broad variety of creations, but a heavily blackboxed device might affect long-term performance and the ability of others to maintain it in a detrimental way. Different types of targets might also introduce some side-effects to the process. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

bottled_superpowers_for_sale.name: Bottled Superpowers for Sale
bottled_superpowers_for_sale.description: You are a tinker specializing in the creation of Bottled Superpowers. You can create various serums, elixirs, mutagens, and fantastic concoctions to grant supernatural, scientific, eldritch, or any other type of superpower to other people. They can have vastly different sources, methods of operation, and ways of integration. However, all Bottled Superpowers are somewhat random; it's hard to create powerful ones, and some methodologies might cause usual tinker problems in the created powers (such as the need for special maintenance, instability over time, etc.). Your tinker restrictions are partly lifted, depending on the kind of Bottled Superpowers you are making and how or to whom you want to apply them. Advice: don't mix too many powers in one subject; use extensive human trials to get rid of some problematic kinks of your product.

carbon_era.name: Carbon Era
carbon_era.description: You can build things out of carbon extremely well. This is your main material. For instance, you can figure out a way to create a fully functional smartphone, which is made of 98% carbon. Carbon metamaterials, nanostructures, and other exotic applications of the element are your bread and butter. However, you are still limited by what is hypothetically possible, and you need to find inspiration for devices in the outside world and the technology around you. This is a methodology type of tinker power. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

clockwork_mechanist.name: Clockwork Mechanist
clockwork_mechanist.description: This tinker power specializes in clockwork and focuses on designing, building, and manipulating intricate mechanical devices and automata. This expertise allows you to create advanced clockwork machines, precision gears, and complex gear-driven systems. You can craft autonomous clockwork robots, intricate locks and traps, or elaborate timekeeping devices. This focus is really great at working with mechanical energy and its transformations. Methodology and possible devices to create are limited by clockwork theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

common_appliances.name: Common Appliances
common_appliances.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation of 'mundane' devices, such as microwaves, freezers, toasters, and similar items. The things you make have the same functionality as their usual non-tinkertech variants, but extended, more efficient and more powerful. You can also attach some exaggerated upgrades to these basic functions if they are thematic - for example, a freezer that can keep perishable items in stasis, or a vacuum capable of absurd levels of suction. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

counter-tinker.name: Counter-Tinker
counter-tinker.description: You are a Tinker focused on countering the works of other Tinkers. You excel at in-depth analysis of the functions and workings of other Tinker-made devices, along with creating the necessary tools to do so. However, your main focus is on creating devices to counter other Tinkertech. You can also create counters to your own creations, but doing so has 'inbreeding' effects - making the counters worse and more dangerous with each generation if you use your own work as inspiration. Unfortunately, you need to observe and research the works of other Tinkers to create anything, though you can still produce most basic tools and sensors within your specialization. Fortunately, you are still free to use counter-devices in any way you want; even if using them for purposes to different than their primary function is less efficient and, in some cases, can complicate maintenance. You can use this power to counter mundane tech, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to your understanding of the targeted technology, and it generally works less well on non-Tinkertech. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted. Advice: target eldritch and alien technology.

cozy_solarpunk.name: Cozy Solarpunk
cozy_solarpunk.description: This tinker power specializes in solarpunk and excels at designing sustainable, eco-friendly machinery and innovative devices that harmonize with nature. All equipment within this focus relies on renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and bioenergy, combined with eco-conscious materials. The development of new devices and techniques is guided by principles of sustainability and ecological balance. Your methodology and creations are limited by the optimistic and environmentally conscious spirit of the solarpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

crazy_edison.name: Crazy Edison
crazy_edison.description: As Tinker specialized in Bulbs and Light Sources, you can create exotic illumination devices that produce mesmerizing and unusual effects, such as cooling, color-shifting, X-ray vision, projecting illusions, literal black light, etc. Think of Bakuda, but with bulbs, less destructive and energy intensive effects. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

daily_hyperfixation.name: Daily Hyperfixation
daily_hyperfixation.description: For 24 hours, you gain a random tinkertech blueprint to work on. After 24 hours pass, the new blueprint you can build appears, and the old one disappears. You need to finish your current fixation project to save the blueprint and be able to build it again. If you cannot finish your current blueprint, all completed parts will be converted into inspiration to modify your previously saved blueprints, thematically related to the unfinished creation. You can finish a blueprint by cutting corners, but the saved blueprint will always be of a device you actually completed at the end of the current 24-hour cycle. So if you build crappy version - you get crappy blueprint. Your state of mind, levels of stress and living situation slightly affect what kind of blueprints you gain. Usually you gain blueprints, which are technically possible for your to finish in 24 hours, but not always. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

dakka.name: Dakka!
dakka.description: You are a tinker focused on Firearms and Bullets. You can create guns and ammunition with ridiculous functions and effects, as long as they stay within the concept of 'firearm.' You cannot make pure laser weapons or plasma cannons, for instance. But a machine gun with homing rocket bullets? That is possible! Think of Bakuda, but with bullets and guns instead of bombs. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

darts_and_blowguns.name: Darts and Blowguns
darts_and_blowguns.description: Your tinker power is about the creation of 'poison' darts and pneumatic delivery systems. You can make darts of bizarre designs and imbued with interesting effects. They can be lethal or non-lethal, positive or negative, or serve some other utility (like tracking). But all these effects are chemically based. The other part is delivery systems - blowguns and similiar devices of various designs and levels of sophistication. However, they all use pneumatics to shoot the darts. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

diesel_industry.name: Diesel Industry
diesel_industry.description: This tinker power specializes in dieselpunk and excels at crafting rugged, retro-futuristic machinery and industrial devices. All machinery within this focus utilizes advanced variations of chemical fuel and highly sophisticated combustion engines to achieve its goals. The use of chemical fuel and combustion is a main component of practically all your designs. Your methodology and the devices you create are limited by the dieselpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

furry_science.name: Furry Science
furry_science.description: This tinker ability is focused on the furry subculture and draws inspiration for its creations from this theme. You can make various devices inspired by this fandom. It can be something mundane, like an advanced fursuit, or something complicated, like a cloned body of an anthropomorphic animal of your design. However, any creation should be inspired by or closely connected to this specific subculture. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted. Having familiarity with this community can greatly help you work with this tinker focus.

low-scale_production.name: Low-Scale Production
low-scale_production.description: You can create specialized machines and devices for the refinement of materials and the creation of simple components. They are easy to automate but are very focused on a single task or narrow application. For example, a small furnace that is extremely good at refining copper from scraps and ore, turning it into high-purity ingots, but it doesn't work on any other metal. You need different machine for doing something else. They are also designed to be low-scale, producing small batches of product. You don't really scale up. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

mirrors_and_mirrors.name: Mirrors and Mirrors!
mirrors_and_mirrors.description: You are a Tinker specializing in Mirrors and Reflection. You can create devices to reflect and mirror various effects. For example, you can create a shield capable of nearly perfect reflection of kinetic energy attempting to break through it, or a hologram projector capable of producing a temporarily physical simulacrum of another person under your control. You have all the usual limitations of a Tinker.

origami_master.name: Origami Master
origami_master.description: Your tinker ability is all about producing and folding paper to achieve your goals. It contains three narrow subcategories of things you are good at: Origami, Papermaking, and Scribbling. Origami is all about folding paper into efficient, useful shapes, and it can be used on other materials as well, but it becomes less effective the further the targeted matter is from the type of paper. Papermaking is focused on creating specialized papers for your work: bulletproof paper, hydrophobic paper, fire-resistant paper, etc. Scribbling is a more exotic craft involving inscribing patterns and text on paper to infuse it with unique added properties or to program it to do something (like folding in a specific way with a trigger condition attached). You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

perpetual_motion.name: Perpetual Motion
perpetual_motion.description: You are a tinker capable of creating various perpetual motion machines. Starting from basic classic designs that actually work to produce mechanical energy, and finishing with more esoteric and fundamental approaches made functional. Although, it is generally easier for you to create machines that can generate a relatively small amount of mechanical energy for an unlimited amount of time (not counting maintenance and other tinkertech-related problems). However, if you have a device on hand, it would be easy to adapt your design to power this specific machine. You have a relatively high upper scaling limit. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

projection_crafting.name: Projection Crafting
projection_crafting.description: This unique tinker focus lets you create 'projections' of existing objects via usage of special custom devices. They function like copies of the original device or item, possessing most of its properties and functions (while not being truly material or permanent). For example, you can create a device to project several copies of a lightsaber to use, while keeping the original one safe. Or use something like an addon for the gun to essentially have infinite bullets, using projected matter to refill the gun. However, all projections created this way are connected to the original and cannot exist without it. At higher levels, you might store 'memory' of the original to partially sidestep this issue, but ultimately, any projection will wear out, warp in shape and function, and eventually collapse without an intact and accessible original to pull from. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

pseudoscience_enjoyer.name: Pseudoscience Enjoyer
pseudoscience_enjoyer.description: Your theme and specialty are rather odd - Pseudoscience. Your creations are inspired by and function like various pseudoscientific devices, using the logic and 'knowledge' of different forms of pseudoscience. These devices are perfectly functional for what you create them for, but they are rather weird and make even less sense than usual Tinketech. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

psi_tradeoff.name: Psi Tradeoff
psi_tradeoff.description: You are a tinker able to create devices that reproduce and simulate various 'psychic' effects. Drawing inspiration from fiction, as well as actual supernatural and magical effects, will help you a lot. However, there is always some tradeoff in using these devices - some kind of mental cost. You can create a small device to achieve telekinetic flight, but at the cost of 4% of your maximum focus while the device is equipped. Or maybe you want to set things on fire with your gaze, but at the cost of permanently burning your own memories in quantities proportional to the complexity and power of the spontaneous combustion you are trying to achieve. Or you might literally spend your 'social battery' to fuel people-targeting psychometry. There is always a tradeoff - always a cost. At least, these devices are much less dangerous when used by you. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

shizotech_fugue.name: Shizotech Fugue
shizotech_fugue.description: On normal days, your tinker power is very good at making simple and robust (by tinkertech standards) tools and stockpiling special materials. But you accumulate charge in this state (which has an upper limit), which you can spend to enter a special kind of fugue. In this state, you turn temporarily schizophrenic and experience heavy hallucinations. What you experience in this state determines what you will build using the materials and tools around you. This fugue is extremely efficient at making you build things, even from subpar materials. It can last up to 48 hours (maximum charge) or until you lose consciousness due to stress and fatigue. In the end, you have some useful and bizarre tinkertech device (or several) with a general idea of what it does, but you need to actually research and test it to figure out the details of maintenance and any special quirks of the created item. The state of your psyche greatly affects the products. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

spider_tinker.name: Spider Tinker
spider_tinker.description: Your tinker focus is all about spiders and their derivative products. You can separate this specialty into three subcategories: Spiders, Products, and Traits. The first is about affecting the actual category of creatures labeled as 'spiders': modifying them, breeding and creating new ones, controlling them, and using them as helpers with tinkertech. The second is all about derivatives: production of various silks, custom toxins, and other spider-related physical materials. The third involves applying the properties of spiders to other things: building primitive spider-bots, creating serums to grant discount Spider-Man powers, etc. This specialty heavily relies on your conceptualization, creativity and knowledge of the theme. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

stone_age_tinker.name: Stone Age Tinker
stone_age_tinker.description: You specialize in the creation of devices, tools, and items from the Neolithic Age and inspired by it. Your material requirements are relatively low and contain a lot of natural, raw materials. Your creations are unusually high quality; they are much more efficient and functional than expected from such seemingly primitive objects. You are capable of creation of non-tinkertech Neolithic items of high quality, but they just very good mundane things. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

sweet-tooth_tinker.name: Sweet-tooth Tinker
sweet-tooth_tinker.description: Your tinker ability is focused on the creation of various sweets to achieve your goals. It contains three broad subcategories of things you are good at: Shaping, Boost and Minions. The first is candy-material science, used to create tools, mechanisms, and devices from sweets with exotic properties. Boost is all about creating sweets that bestow positive or negative effects - temporarily (or permanently, if you try really hard) - on a target. Minions is all about creating sweets golems, animated and life-like creatures to help you with work or fighting. All your creations are technically edible. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

tacticool_attachments.name: Tacticool Attachments
tacticool_attachments.description: You are a tinker specialized in the creation of attachments for other devices. You should research and focus on a specific technological item to start building, testing and improving various add-ons for it, which can extend, deepen, or otherwise upgrade the main or secondary functions of the object. Things like an unusually efficient silencer for your pistol or perhaps a battery attachment to extend your force field charge. However, everything you create must be attached to and be a derivative of another device. Your understanding of the functions of the targeted item is very helpful. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

taxidermy_enthusiast.name: Taxidermy Enthusiast
taxidermy_enthusiast.description: As Taxidermy Tinker you can create strange, animated hybrid creatures and eerie sculptures using preserved animals, bones, and mechanical parts. Your works are often bizarre and unsettling, but not alive. You require organic materials and simple mechanisms, but your creations are short-lived and dependent on available resources. You have problems working with human bodies, or any other materials too distant from 'animal' definition. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

the_art_of_retrofitting.name: The Art of Retrofitting
the_art_of_retrofitting.description: Your tinker ability is uniquely centered around the concept of retrofitting - transforming and upgrading existing devices, structures, and systems into new, more advanced forms. You excel at taking old, outdated, or broken technology and infusing it with innovative modifications, turning it into something far more capable than its original design. Whether it's retrofitting a simple machine to handle complex tasks, upgrading a worn-out device with cutting-edge components, or repurposing old technology for modern use, you thrive on creatively reimagining the potential of what already exists. Your expertise lies in customizing and enhancing rather than inventing from scratch. However, your retrofitting process often results in devices that are unpredictable or temperamental - sometimes working flawlessly, other times malfunctioning in unexpected ways. This can lead to surprising outcomes. The more outdated and old the technology you are working with, the more efficient this ability is. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

think-tanks.name: Think-Tanks
think-tanks.description: Your tinker power is focused on the creation of cloned brains in boxes. You can create copies of brains (yours or other people's), download knowledge, personality, and data into them, then put these brains into jars and force them to think up ideas and solutions for you using various mastering techniques, brainwashing and various similar methods. Completely unethical, and you must ensure from time to time that these brains won't try to betray you by booby-trapping some of their ideas. However, it is really efficient for offloading solution searching and brute-forcing creativity. This specialty doesn't let you create anything else but think-tanks and will oppose you if you try to use it to create something else (like fully functional clones). Although, it includes methods of quickly and efficiently coping results from think-tanks and implanting these ideas into your head. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

tinker_of_escalation.name: Tinker of Escalation
tinker_of_escalation.description: Your tinker power revolves around the concept of Escalation. It allows you to push existing devices and systems beyond their original limits, increasing their power, complexity, and unpredictability. While you can turn simple gadgets into formidable or unstoppable creations, your escalations often cause unpredictable ripple effects in the environment, making your inventions prone to instability or chaos (you are less affected personally). The more pressure is applied from outside, the faster and more effectively your Escalation potential grows and quicker it can be turned into upgrades. However, if you suddenly stop escalating the acceleration 'counter' resets, and all devices built by you begin to malfunction more often, requiring more maintenance and quickly losing their power, potential and danger. This is a methodology-type of tinker power - you need outside inspiration or devices to use as a starting point for the process. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

wondrous_metals.name: Wondrous Metals
wondrous_metals.description: As a tinker specialized in fictional metals, you can synthesize such wondrous materials and produce simple objects made from them. You can create tools to actually work with these materials. It is possible for you to create a specific type of mithril, for instance. However, you must draw your inspiration from a particular work of fiction. Some materials are harder to make and use than others, some are more powerful, and some are closer to the original source of inspiration. The intangible value and theme of the fictional work greatly affect the results of your tinkering, as well as depth and quantity of information given about the metal. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

administrator_engine.name: Administrator Engine
administrator_engine.description: This metaperk automatically connects to all other perks and powers you have and updates when you acquire new ones. Its primary goal is the management and control of the various effects that powers give you. It grants you the ability to tune and even turn powers on or off, even for ones which usually don't have any means of control. You can preprogram various quick changes to tweak the operation of many abilities at once, giving you more precise control over the abilities you possess and making it easier to monitor what they do and when. Of course, it works a bit differently with different perks and tries to adapt to them. Basically, it just gives a control panel to better monitor and manage your powers.

aspect_loom.name: Aspect Loom
aspect_loom.description: You can unravel matter and energy into thick, colorful threads and wind them into balls that represent aspects of an object. Simply touching your target starts the process. These threads can be stored in a special pocket dimension and accessed at any time. If you haven't altered the threads, you can turn them back into the original objects. The mass, volume, and complexity of the target determine how many threads you obtain and how easy/hard it is to do, but it will always be lesser in mass and volume than the original unraveled object. You can split these threads into more, unraveling the nature of the object into simpler aspects. Using different threads, you can create patterns so that when they are reassembled, the resulting object will be different - made of aspects of your original target and inspired by the new shape. You are an expert in working with threads and possess an unnatural intuition for manipulating aspect threads specifically. Others can also work with these threads and even restore them into objects using the right supernatural energies or abilities, but without your unnatural intuition, it is difficult for them to find effective or useful patterns.

dionysus_ultimate_blessing.name: Dionysus Ultimate Blessing
dionysus_ultimate_blessing.description: You cannot die from overdrinking; at some point, it will stop worsening. Any damage caused by drinking will be healed by a short hangover afterward. You do not suffer from the usual side effects of alcoholism, such as developing a tolerance to alcohol. While you are at least a little bit drunk, you cannot be poisoned by other substances. Your luck slightly increases with how drunk you are at the moment, though there is a limit. You are extremely knowledgeable about cocktails, alcoholic beverages, and how to drink them correctly. You can consume methanol or similar "alcoholic" substances without dying, going blind, or experiencing other severe consequences, but the hangover will be longer and much worse. You can still get drunk, even if other powers prohibit or make it impossible. You can experience degrees of drunkenness beyond what an unmodified human brain can normally comprehend. If you want to get intoxicated from drinking at the moment - you will!

escalating_harm.name: Escalating Harm
escalating_harm.description: Once you land an initial strike on an opponent, your subsequent attacks against the same target grow increasingly devastating. Each successive blow deals twice the damage of the previous one. For example, if your first hit causes a minor abrasion, the second strike will be twice as severe, and the third strike will be four times as severe as the first. This escalation resets if you switch targets and rapidly decays, if you pause between attacks for too long. The ability only functions if your first attack deals meaningful damage. It doesn't work if your first attack didn't deal enough damage and can the effect can be interrupted by other exotic effects.

fire_fiends_creation.name: Fire Fiends Creation
fire_fiends_creation.description: You can create free fire spirits or infuse items with them using living things you have burned down yourself as the source - either from their ashes or by literally dragging specks of "inner fire" from the corpses of your foes. These "fiends" need to eat fire or highly flammable materials to survive, but even then, they have limited and usually short lifespans because they age relatively quickly. They are generally aligned with you, listen to your orders, and are loyal, but tend to be mischievous and "fiery" in character due to their nature. They live longer when infused into objects, but their effects are less powerful in that form. Depending on exotic and unqiue properties of things you burnt to create them, friends might possess some traces of traits and characteristics of the burnt object.

fluid_light.name: Fluid Light
fluid_light.description: You are capable of absorbing light with the surface of your body, turning it into a transparent fluid and excreting it from any point on your body. Disturbing this substance causes it to partly revert back into light (for example, by suddenly heating it or punching it hard). This liquid is practically weightless and has very low viscosity. However, you can concentrate more light into the same volume of liquid. Doing so will make it heavier and more viscous, the more light you pack into it. Additionally, disturbing it will produce brighter light with a shorter wavelength. You are good at absorbing visible light but terrible at absorbing non-visible light. There is a limit to how much you can absorb, store, and recycle per unit of time.

just_pop_it.name: Just Pop It
just_pop_it.description: You can cause almost any physical object or part of it to pop, as if it were a balloon - simply by applying enough pressure or using something like a needle. Larger and more massive objects explode with greater power. After performing the 'pop' action, you have a short window of invulnerability to protect you from the explosion itself and some of the shards it produces, but nothing beyond that. You have perfect control over when this ability is active.

metaphorical_flames.name: Metaphorical Flames
metaphorical_flames.description: You can use metaphorical sources of flame inside and around you to fuel your magic. For example, you can draw upon your own flaming rage or fires of will to produce mystical effects. Doing so will make these inner fires burn brighter for a time, but they will also turn to cold ash more quickly. This means that if you use something like rage or willpower as fuel, they will temporarily intensify, only to burn out afterward - leaving behind disinterest, apathy, or similar emotional numbness. You will need to restore them before they can be used again. As such, it is often wiser to use something like the potential flames trapped inside gunpowder on your person as fuel, even if such sources may be less effective or nearly impossible to utilize for certain tasks. Sourcing metaphorical flames requires creativity and careful thought. Some sources are easier or better suited for particular magical tasks than others, and the type of flame you use may influence the resulting magic. For instance, you cannot directly use the flames of another person's rage, but if you bait them into focusing their anger on you, it becomes easier to draw upon. Similarly, using flames of rage is well-suited for violent tasks, though the magic may take on side-effects associated with anger: effects that become much more pronounced if the task already aligns closely with the concept of rage. Not everything can serve as a source; it must be some form of metaphorical flame, or at the very least, fuel for one.

mortis_essence_accumulation.name: Mortis Essence Accumulation
mortis_essence_accumulation.description: You have a metaphorical vessel of 'mortis essence' inside your soul. You can replenish this magic by killing or witnessing death personally. You become stronger and can restore powers in places drenched in death or strongly associated with the dead, as recognized by the local population or creatures in the area. You gain more from killing or witnessing the death of someone who resists death or being killed. You also gain more from sleeping or meditating in places associated with the dead. Different creatures, types of death, and locations influence your replenishment. You cannot accumulate too much mortis essence, as it makes you more vulnerable to death: stopping bleeding takes longer, severe wounds are more likely to cause death, you get ill more easily, etc. So, you need to find a way to get rid of the excess or figure out how to block/control automatic replenishment of the essence before it kills you. Mortis essence is strongly aligned with arts related to death and the dead, such as necromancy or burial arts, but is not limited to them.

ocean_of_bouillon.name: Ocean of Bouillon
ocean_of_bouillon.description: You can instantly conjure great quantities of fresh, boiling-hot (or cold, depending on the dish), and delicious soup, broth or stew in any targeted empty vessel. It must be some kind of mundane soup, broth or stew, and you should be somewhat familiar with specific dish to actually summon it. The substance created this way is enhanced to be perpetually hot (or cold, depending on the dish) and fresh until eaten or ruined by external factors (like dirt getting into it). After that, these special properties gradually (or abruptly) diminish and disappear completely. You can instantly fill a cauldron with your favorite stew, definitely a tub, or even the whole room. It just needs to be some non-living vessel with physical access to its insides. There is a limit of how much you can create at once, but its a lot of stew/soup/broth.

oddly_convenient_spare_parts.name: Oddly Convenient Spare Parts
oddly_convenient_spare_parts.description: When breaking down or disassembling something, you can often find spare parts inside, even if there shouldn't be any. While you cannot precisely control which spare part you will get, you can steer it slightly in the desired direction. Repeatedly disassembling and reassembling objects allows you to dupe pieces with each iteration. Although, there are diminishing returns for doing it to the exact same thing over and over again. The terms 'disassembly' and 'something' are quite flexible - breaking rocks with a pickaxe or preparing wood also technically count as disassembling. As a result, you may find yourself with more spare parts or useful items than expected, even in these cases. Very rarely, when searching for space parts, you might discover unique, thematic items related to what you disassembled among spare parts - for example, finding a golden nugget in a piece of rock you broke down, even if it shouldn’t be there. You also have a knack for dismantling objects quickly, safely and carefully. Nothing supernatural though.

resources_conversion.name: Resources Conversion
resources_conversion.description: You have an inventory space size of one cubic meter. You can put resources, materials, and even some components into this extradimensional space with a touch, as long as they are not larger than a cube with a side of one meter. Things inside this space will be converted from one resource into another after specific time passes. How long this takes depends on three parameters: Properties, Composition, and Shape. How different these three between the original target and intended result. For example, you can put one type of steel into this space and turn it into another of your liking in a matter of minutes: one alloy of iron transformed into another. You are only aware of how long the transformation will take after putting something inside the space and choosing end state of conversion. You can eject items at any time (they will remain unchanged if not enough time has passed for full processing) and must do so if you want to change what is currently contained in this cubic dimension (you cannot add stuff, while something is inside). Trying to turn something into a completely different type of entity might take years and even decades to process, which is usually not worth it. Some small amount of material gets lost in the conversion process, proportionally to how much time it took to convert. End result depends on what you are asking this power to do, but cannot be anything but resource, material or component.

tearful_pellets.name: Tearful Pellets
tearful_pellets.description: You possess the ability to project and throw small pellets that burst into a cloud of capsaicin-derived substance, similar to tear gas but potentially stronger. You have control over the volume of gas clouds each pellet produces when you create it and the potency of substance. You are immune to the effects of the tear gas in general, allowing you to navigate through the cloud unharmed. Pellets do not persist for long - they disappear after some time, if they lose contact with you and/or not being used/destroyed.

transmutative_rise.name: Transmutative Rise
transmutative_rise.description: You gain the ability to transmute matter through touch. Target a volume of up to one liter and one kilogram in weight that you can physically separate from its surroundings. After several minutes of focus, the targeted matter glows briefly and transmutes, increasing the atomic number of each element within by exactly one. The time required scales with the atomic number of the elements involved. Turning iron (26) into cobalt (27), for example, takes approximately twenty minutes of concentration. The transmutation produces stable isotopes whenever possible, though there may be logical, unexpected, or even dangerous consequences, albeit somewhat softened from what physics would normally dictate.

wooden_stake.name: Wooden Stake
wooden_stake.description: You possess the ability to rapidly grow and produce dead wood from your own body. This wood can take on various shapes such as beams, stakes, thorns, curved branches, and other pointy objects. You have the flexibility to make them hollow or alter their inner structure or surface for a little while, even making them polished. Your power does not tarnish your clothes or other thin materials around you (if you don't want it to). The wood you create is dark, dense, and exceptionally hard. It is resistant to catching fire, but if it does ignite, it burns rapidly. It is very susceptible to natural decay and rots relatively quickly over time. You have the power to infuse existing or created wood (including alive) with your energy. For instance, you can charge a small piece of wood, throw it, and after a certain time, it will begin to transform into preprogrammed pointed shapes, resembling your own body’s abilities, until the charge is depleted. Alternatively, you can grow wood from other wooden surfaces that you come into contact with. Charged wood, under your control, can be easily broken by you and poses no harm to you.

complete_modifier.name: Complete Modifier
complete_modifier.description: You can apply modifiers inspired by Path of Exile mechanics to your own creations. Any item you are personally in the process of making (be it a device, weapon, armor, landmark, creature, or similar) is a valid target for modification. This process works best on things analogous to entities that could be modified in the original game. The cost in time and resources scales proportionally with the power of the modifiers and the nature of the target creation. Some modifiers are easier to apply to certain things, some modifiers work better and in more predictable way when applied to certain things.

not_enough_flasks.name: Not Enough Flasks
not_enough_flasks.description: You gain the ability to create any of the various flasks from the Path of Exile game. You possess an encyclopedic knowledge of their properties and effects, along with a general understanding of their practical application. These flasks function in a manner highly inspired by their in-game mechanics.

quality_items.name: Quality Items
quality_items.description: You can spend additional time and resources to improve the quality of a targeted item, inspired by Path of Exile mechanics. This process is more difficult for item types not originally covered by the game's quality system. The effort and cost involved scale with the complexity and power of the item. Quality is significantly easier to apply when you are creating an item from scratch.

skill_gems.name: Skill Gems
skill_gems.description: You gain the ability to create skill gems and craft the necessary item sockets to apply them to various objects. In addition, you possess an encyclopedic knowledge of all skill gems from the Path of Exile universe, along with the expertise to use them effectively.

acquire_skills.name: Acquire Skills
acquire_skills.description: Upon purchasing this perk, you may select any single skill from the full list of skills existing in the RimWorld game. This chosen skill is held in reserve, waiting to be applied. You may bestow it upon yourself or upon another person you touch - a process that takes a few minutes of concentration to complete. The effect grants two levels of proficiency in the chosen skill to the target, up to a maximum of 20. These skill levels integrate naturally, as though gained through genuine experience and practice. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each purchase granting another skill level reserve to choose, hold and apply.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific foundation, basic practical skills, and complete blueprints for all technology, containment procedures, and projects from the Anomaly DLC for RimWorld. You gain the knowledge to construct anomaly research facilities, containment devices, and the specialized equipment needed to study and exploit the unnatural. Crucially, any potential infohazards or mind-breaking knowledge contained within this perk are automatically hidden from your conscious awareness if learning them would harm you. You receive only what you can safely handle.

biotech.name: Biotech
biotech.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific foundation, basic practical skills, and complete blueprints for all technology and projects from the Biotech DLC for RimWorld. You gain the knowledge to genetically engineer xenotypes, oversee mechanitor operations, manage children and genetic lineages, and construct all associated machinery and facilities. The mysteries of mechanoid control and genetic manipulation are now yours to command.

ideology.name: Ideology
ideology.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific foundation, basic practical skills, a degree of supernatural ability, and complete blueprints for all technology, structures, and projects from the Ideology DLC for RimWorld. You understand how to construct ritual altars, relic display cases, and all ideoligion-associated buildings and items. Additionally, this perk grants you a measure of supernatural ability tied to faith and belief, along with enhanced social aptitude and exceptional talent in all social sciences. You understand how beliefs shape civilizations and can navigate even the most complex ideological landscapes with ease. As with all dangerous knowledge, any potential infohazards contained within this perk are automatically hidden if learning them would hurt you.

industrial_projects.name: Industrial Projects
industrial_projects.description: You gain the knowledge and all necessary skills to build and create items from Industrial Research Projects from the base RimWorld game. This includes both specific blueprints for every craftable Industrial-era structure, fabrication bench, machining table, component assembly, and advanced device, along with a basic level of practical skill sufficient to construct them from available materials. This perk covers only content from the core RimWorld experience and does not include any DLC content.

neolithic_projects.name: Neolithic Projects

obtain_traits.name: Obtain Traits
obtain_traits.description: Upon purchasing this perk, you may select any single trait from the full list of traits existing in the RimWorld game. This chosen trait is held in reserve, waiting to be applied. You may bestow it upon yourself or upon another person you touch - a process that takes a few minutes of concentration to complete. The effect causes permanent physiological and/or psychological changes to the target, integrating the trait as though it were always part of their nature. Identical traits do not stack, and attempting to apply multiple traits that conflict or interact unpredictably may have unintended consequences. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each purchase granting another trait to hold in reserve for later application. Beware of unintended psychological or physiological effects: tampering with someone's fundamental nature rarely comes without risk.

odyssey.name: Odyssey
odyssey.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific foundation, basic practical skills, and complete blueprints for all technology and projects from the Odyssey DLC for RimWorld. You gain the knowledge to construct and utilize all Odyssey-specific additions - including new vehicles, exploration equipment, and the various technologies that enable expanded travel and discovery across the rimworlds.

redistribute_passion.name: Redistribute Passion
redistribute_passion.description: This perk grants you three metaphorical charges each day, which you can use to temporarily bestow Passion toward any skill from the list of those existing in the RimWorld game. By investing one charge, you can make yourself (or another) become Interested in that skill; by investing two charges, you can elevate that interest to Burning Passion. This effect does not actually make you more skillful, it does not grant knowledge or ability. Instead, it allows you to take genuine pleasure in performing tasks related to that skill and provides a significant multiplier on experience gain while the passion lasts. All three charges must be used simultaneously when activating this perk. They reset every 24 hours and need to be reapplied if you wish to maintain the effect. You may apply these charges to other people, but if you do, the charges will only return to you after 24 hours have passed. Be mindful of unintended psychological effects - artificially induced passion can sometimes have unexpected consequences on a person's psyche.

royalty.name: Royalty
