a_dollar.name: A Dollar
a_dollar.description: "$$$" - This perk gives you 100 Pennies. In this case, Pennies are imaginary and immaterial unspecified currency, which you can materialize into actual money at any moment. It works only one way - Pennies into material currency, but be sure - now you have some sizable sum in your metaphorical (and soon literal) pocket!

a_pony.name: A Pony
a_pony.description: "Flight + Dash Attack." - This stick horse grants the ability to fly and passively increases your speed. When activated, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, gaining a degree of invulnerability during the dash and dealing damage to enemies in your path. The active ability has a cooldown. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

anarchist_cookbook.name: Anarchist Cookbook
anarchist_cookbook.description: "Summon bombs." - This is an actual Anarchist Cookbook and can be read like any normal text. It is more in-depth and factual than a standard copy, and provides a slight passive boost to learning and using the knowledge contained within. Its active effect spawns seven primed explosive devices of reasonable power at random points nearby, which detonate after a few seconds. The book has a cooldown and grants the wielder general knowledge of its effects and usage upon equipping it.

best_friend.name: Best Friend
best_friend.description: "Friends 'till the end." - This small doll, when activated, spawns a decoy that explodes after five seconds. Enemies are attracted to the decoy and lose track of the user. The effect has a cooldown. The decoy resembles a person lying on the ground, but can take on different appearances and illusory details to better draw enemies' attention.

blood_rights.name: Blood Rights
blood_rights.description: "Mass Enemy Damage at a Cost." - You gain a straight razor artifact with special properties, along with basic knowledge of how to use it. When you cut yourself with this razor (an action that deals consistent damage but causes no bleeding) it inflicts burst of damage on everyone you perceive as an enemy in your immediate vicinity, primarily in the form of internal trauma and spontaneous cuts. Used on others, the razor is simply an exceptionally durable and always-sharp blade. The main effect has a cooldown, and the razor provides feedback to its current user about when it can be used again.

bloody_gust.name: Bloody Gust
bloody_gust.description: “May your rage bring haste.” - Each time you take damage in combat, your speed and agility receive a temporary boost. This effect can stack up to six stages, increasing with each hit. The boost decays rapidly once you are no longer fighting.

book_of_revelations.name: Book of Revelations
book_of_revelations.description: "Reusable soul protection." - This item, upon use, grants one soul heart. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts. There is a small chance of encountering the Harbinger boss attacking you shortly after using the book. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a relatively long cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

book_of_shadows.name: Book of Shadows
book_of_shadows.description: "Temporary invincibility." - This item creates a protective shield, nullifying almost all types of damage for 10 seconds upon activation. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.description: "Blood laser barrage." - This perk lets you shoot blood laser beam from your mouth that pierces through enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period. This perk can be purchased twice to get upgraded version.

candy_heart.name: Candy Heart
candy_heart.description: "Power of Love." This perk grants you incremental upgrades to a few randomly chosen physical stats after healing from wounds. It only works if the healed wound was severe enough and the healing process was fast enough (like regeneration). The upgrades are tiny but permanent.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: "Outbreak!" - The first enemy killed in a battle releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies in small radius. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect. This gas is not permanent, existing only for a short moment.

cracked_orb.name: Cracked Orb
cracked_orb.description: “Shards of Knowledge”. - Each time you take damage exceeding a certain threshold, you gain one of the following boons: useful insight about your surroundings; the opening of nearby closed or blocked passages; or useful items from the surrounding area being uncovered and brought to your attention. The effect is mostly random, but is influenced by your environment and current situation.

dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
dead_eye.description: "Accuracy Bbrings power!" - This perk increases damage each time an enemy is hit by your attack. The damage bonus resets when you miss a shot. This effect has a certain bonus limit and does not work for some types of attacks (like lasers). You can toggle the effect on and off.

empty_heart.name: Empty Heart
empty_heart.description: “It multiplies”. - This perk allows you to fully recover from grievous injuries and any negative side effects of wounds or ailments once your health drops below a certain threshold. The healing occurs at your normal recovery speed. For example, it could mend a poorly healed bone fracture, though minor scars or traces may remain. It may even restore a lost eye (fully or partially) depending on your current state of health. With each full recovery, you grow a little hardier, capable of surviving greater trauma before succumbing to your wounds.

epiphora.name: Epiphora
epiphora.description: "Intensifying tears." - Shooting in one direction increases your rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as you change direction or stop shooting, the rate of fire resets to its normal amount. The effectiveness of the effect depends on the type of attack used. You can toggle this ability.

forget_me_now.name: Forget Me Now
forget_me_now.description: "I don't remember..." - This perk grants you a special pill that allows you to "reset" your day once. Immediately after taking it, you travel back 24 hours. You retain all items on your person, your memories, and your other perks, as well as your current physical state. For example, if you are wounded at the moment of activation, you will remain wounded after the reset. This perk may be purchased multiple times. Note that traveling back does not guarantee events will unfold the same way. The perk itself provides general knowledge of the pill's effect to you.

glowing_hourglass.name: Glowing Hourglass
glowing_hourglass.description: "Turn back time." - Upon active use, this item rewinds time to the last major branching point in your timeline - a moment where small choices can lead to significant changes. This typically sends you back a few minutes, but can sometimes rewind up to an hour or even a full day. Only your mind travels back; your body, items, and surroundings remain as they were. The hourglass holds three charges and can be used three times. Repeated use cannot take you further back than 24 hours from the moment of the previous activation, meaning you cannot rewind twice in quick succession to exceed that limit. The only way to recharge it is to purchase this perk again (at half price - 400 CP), though the hourglass can never store more than three charges. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

guppys_collar.name: Guppy's Collar
guppys_collar.description: "Eternal life?" - This perk grants a permanent 50% chance to respawn with a highly diminished state of health after death. You are not wounded after respawning, just fragile.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: "Holy death shot." -This perk allows you to either: add a chance to fire a 'holy shot' - a modification of your ranged attack that creates a damaging light beam in the area if it hits an enemy; or apply this effect to your attack intentionally, but with a specific cooldown between each application. You can toggle the effect of this perk, or even turn it off.

holy_mantle.name: Holy Mantle
holy_mantle.description: "Holy shield." - This perk grants an invisible shield/barrier that negates the first instance of damage taken. It takes some time to recharge and cooldown is lower when outside immediate danger or battle. It works against most types of damage, but not all of them.

incubus.name: Incubus
incubus.description: "Dark Friend." - This perk allows you to spawn and dismiss a demonic familiar that floats nearby you and shoots ranged attacks identical to your current ones in terms of damage, rate of fire and special effects. For example, if you are using a Tommy gun with tungsten bullets, the Incubus will mimic this ranged attack.

keepers_sack.name: Keeper's Sack
keepers_sack.description: "Balls." - Each time you purchase something from a willing trader, you receive a random permanent physical stat upgrade proportional to your spending. The effect works best for large, one-time, in-person expenditures where actual goods are exchanged and the sum spent is significant enough to trigger it. The perk is highly particular about what qualifies as a "purchase" and cannot be easily cheated.

monstrance.name: Monstrance
monstrance.description: "Purifying light." - This perk gives you the ability to turn on an aura, which deals damage to enemies inside it. The closer they are, the more damage is dealt. Effect looks like a brightened area around you and a dim light. It is not perfect at telling apart enemies from friends and can be deceived. It deals damage in a form of sunburns.

pjs.name: PJs
pjs.description: "You feel cozy." - This perk grants you 4 'soul hearts' and fully restores your health. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts.

playdough_cookie.name: Playdough Cookie
playdough_cookie.description: "Tasty rainbow." - This perk let's you turn your shots multicolored. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect applied to the shot. Colours and effects for each projectile is random, when active.

pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
pyromaniac.description: "It hurts so good +5 bombs." - This perk grants immunity to explosion damage and fire damage. It also causes explosions to heal you. More exotic flame/explosion effects might still affect you negatively or interact weirdly with this power.

red_candle.name: Red Candle
red_candle.description: "Flame on." - This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of strangely persistent fire. It will burn in the targeted location for some time, scorching the surrounding area, and can be moved by strong enough wind or force while it lasts.

restock.name: Restock
restock.description: "Never ending stores!" - This is a metaperk that allows you to purchase subsequently rolled perks multiple times for one roll. Each additional copy costs 200 CP more than the last. Perks bought this way will stack or fuse to increase their quality or quantity. You may also choose to buy the perk repeatedly as separate "copies" to give away later. For example, if your next roll is a free perk, you could purchase it again for 200 CP, then again for 400 CP, and so on - either stacking the effects with what you already have or holding them to distribute later. Restock does not affect other metaperks, nor does it function if the rolled perk can already be purchased multiple times as part of its normal function.

rock_bottom.name: Rock Bottom
rock_bottom.description: "It's only up from there." - This perk revents your physical attributes from falling below their highest values reached. Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use your current stats, items and effects will impact the same way they would as if you did not have Rock Bottom. Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off. Basically, stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.

spoon_bender.name: Spoon Bender
spoon_bender.description: "Homing shots." - This perk grants you the ability to apply a homing effect to your ranged/projectile-based attacks, inspired by The Binding of Isaac. Projectiles/attacks naturally curve toward the nearest enemy in the vicinity. You have no manual control over the targeting; instead, you must position yourself strategically to influence where the shots go. The effect adapts slightly depending on the type of ranged attack you use and has some in-build synergies for specific types of attacks.

steam_sale.name: Steam Sale
steam_sale.description: "50% off". - This is a metaperk. Your next perk roll will have its price automatically cut in half. For example, reducing a 100 CP perk to 50 CP. Perks that cost 50 CP or less become free. If your next roll results in a free perk, Steam Sale does not apply this way. Afterward, there is a 10% chance that all perks purchased following Steam Sale first trigger will also be 50% off by the same rules as the first one was.

stop_watch.name: Stop Watch
stop_watch.description: "Let's slow this fown a bit..." - This perk slightly increases your movement and reaction speed. It alters perception to make things move only at 80% of their speed from your point of view, without losing any understanding of events happening around you. It takes some time for the brain to adapt to this new reality. This power can be toggled.

the_candle.name: The Candle
the_candle.description: "Reusable flames." - This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of blue fire, which disintegrates things on contact and diminishes quickly. It works better against living and organic matter. A wisp of blue fire is hard to move after it has been thrown.

the_compass.name: The Compass
the_compass.description: "The end is near." - This perk gives you a mental compass in the back of your mind, which points you toward places of interest nearby in your current location. It might take some time to figure out what the Compass is showing you, but behind all the symbols it uses, there is logic and system. It cannot reveal places, which are hidden too well and intentionally.

the_hourglass.name: The Hourglass
the_hourglass.description: "Temporary enemy slowdown." - You gain an hourglass that can slow down everyone you perceive as enemies within your vicinity for eight seconds. It has a cooldown between uses. The item provides feedback on its recharge status and imparts knowledge of its use to the holder. The effect is not temporal in nature, but inertial/kinetic: it does not slow the perception of time.

the_wafer.name: The Wafer
the_wafer.description: "Damage resistance." - Most sources of harm that would cause more damage than a certain threshold will only deal a fraction of it: a deep bruise, a cracked rib, or similar injury depending on the strike's location. This protection has limits. It is less effective, or may not function at all, against certain forms of damage.

white_pony.name: White Pony
white_pony.description: "Flight + holy death." - This stick horse grants flight and passively increases your speed. When activated, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, gaining a degree of invulnerability during the dash, dealing damage to enemies struck, and creating damaging beams of light trailing behind you. The active ability has a cooldown. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

yum_heart.name: Yum Heart
yum_heart.description: "Reusable regeneration." - This soft, heart-shaped object is edible. Taking a bite instantly restores a significant amount of health, though it does not heal status effects. It is highly effective against wounds and the physical consequences of things like toxins. It has limited effect on cancer, genetic damage, or similar conditions, but can address more physical forms of harm such as brain or radiation damage. After each use, the item enters a cooldown period before it can be bitten again. Upon equipping it, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

biters_and_other_pests.name: Biters and Other Pests
biters_and_other_pests.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of research on the various hostile lifeforms found throughout Factorio: from the humble biter to the devastating behemoth worms, including all variants introduced in the Space Age expansion. You understand their biology, behavior patterns, hive dynamics, and evolution triggers in intimate detail. Beyond theoretical knowledge, you have developed exceptional tactical skills for engaging and exploiting these creatures. You know how to manipulate their aggression, draw them into killzones, and neutralize even the largest swarms with minimal resources. More importantly, you possess a natural talent for researching alien hostile life and developing effective countermeasures (whether chemical, biological, or mechanical) against such evolutionary threats.

blue_science.name: Blue Science
blue_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style chemical science and fluid handling. This perk provides you with basic understanding of oil processing, chemical plants, and fluid management. True mastery comes through application. By building refineries, managing complex fluid networks, and proactively utilizing chemical science, you will gradually expand your capabilities. Each innovation unlocks further possibilities until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's chemical production.

gray_science.name: Gray Science
gray_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style military production. This perk provides you with basic understanding of turrets, ammunition, and defensive structures. However, true mastery requires conflict. By building military devices, defending against threats, and actively engaging in battles, you will rapidly expand your capabilities. Actual combat using your creations provides the best returns: each skirmish teaching you how to improve your military technology until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's weaponry.

green_science.name: Green Science
green_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style logistics and belt-based automation. This perk provides you with basic understanding of transport belts, inserters, and simple material distribution. True mastery comes through application. By building logistics networks, optimizing supply chains, and proactively designing distribution systems, you will gradually expand your capabilities. Each innovation unlocks further possibilities until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's logistics content.

purple_science.name: Purple Science
purple_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style production optimization. This perk provides you with basic understanding of advanced circuits, electric furnaces, and productivity modules. True mastery comes through large-scale application. By building production lines, manufacturing a variety of advanced items, and proactively optimizing your processes, you will gradually expand your capabilities. Each innovation unlocks further possibilities until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's production science.

red_science.name: Red Science
red_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style automation. This perk provides you with basic theoretical understanding and practical skills: enough to craft your first burner miners, stone furnaces, and assemble simple automation setups. However, this is only the beginning. True mastery comes through application. By building machines, designing production lines, and proactively automating processes, you will gradually expand your knowledge and capabilities. Each new innovation unlocks further possibilities, allowing you to progress through increasingly complex technologies until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's automation content.

space_age.name: Space Age
space_age.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of theoretical scientific knowledge and blueprints for every craftable item from the Space Age expansion for Factorio. This includes the technologies required for interplanetary logistics, asteroid processing, advanced platform construction, and the unique resources and production chains found on new worlds. Simply possessing this knowledge is only the beginning. Applying these blueprints and theories in practice will help you gain expertise in the usage and creation of these technologies at an incredibly rapid rate: allowing your actual skills and practical understanding to advance in leaps and bounds with each new build.

white_science.name: White Science
white_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style space technology. This perk provides you with basic understanding of rocket construction, satellite payloads, and the principles needed to reach beyond your home world. True mastery requires exploration. By building space-bound devices, launching rockets, and proactively traveling through space using knowledge from this perk, you will rapidly expand your capabilities. Actual space exploration and travel provide the best returns: each new frontier teaching you how to improve your space-faring technology until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's celestial ambitions.

yellow_science.name: Yellow Science
yellow_science.description: You gain the foundational knowledge required to begin your journey into Factorio-style high technology and utility science. This perk provides you with basic understanding of processing units, low-density structures, and rocket control units. True mastery comes through advanced application. By building complex devices, manufacturing cutting-edge items, and proactively utilizing high-tech knowledge, you will gradually expand your capabilities. Each innovation unlocks further possibilities until you have mastered the full breadth of Factorio's advanced technology.

builders_might.name: Builder's Might
builders_might.description: You have access to powers inspired by a player character from the Minecraft game. You abilities can summarized as: >Force - You belong to a race of Builders capable of channeling a unique Force to empower their actions and intended functions of thier tools. This energy makes tools more efficient, weapons more dangerous, and has many other applications - some obvious, others requiring discovery and practice to master. >Inventory - Builders possess a personal pocket dimension for storing items and materials. Storage capacity depends on volume, mass, and material diversity. Objects inside are frozen in time, but creatures with complex enough minds or strong willed can resist being stored quote easily. >Crafting - Builders can manipulate materials stored in their inventory, either subtly or by projecting their work externally - allowing collaboration and easier visualization. When combined with Force, they can even reshape items outside their inventory. By studying an object, they gain its blueprint, enabling them to replicate it if they have the necessary materials, skills, and tools. >Building - Builders can construct structures that defy conventional architecture, such as floating islands, by subtly altering the mass of matter in exotic way. These effects can be disrupted by sufficient force or degrade slowly over time due to wear and tear. >Peak Body - A Builder's Force constantly preserves their body, granting biological immortality, rapid healing, and even regeneration of lost limbs over time. Severe injuries may drain bodily resources, increasing hunger and thirst. They are also significantly tougher, stronger, and more resilient than an average human, with their body striving to return to its peak state when resources are available and being able to quickly replenish energy and materials via eating. >Awareness - Builders have heightened awareness of their own bodies, enhancing agility, dexterity, and speed, and allowing them to learn or relearn skills quickly. They instinctively know if they are ill or poisoned and, with enough experience, can identify the cause. >Respawn - By sleeping in a safe place with a calm mind and intent, you can set a spawn point. Upon death, you may respawn there once every 24 hours, though you temporarily weaken and lose all items. Respawn only works if the location remains intact, your soul is whole, and no heavy dimensional barriers interfere.

crating_book.name: Crating Book
crating_book.description: You have access to a mental compendium containing blueprints for all craftable items from the Minecraft game (inspired by it). This compendium does not grant you skill or knowledge of the intricate inner workings of what you build, nor does it include variations of the same blueprint - it provides only a list of specific items you know how to craft. For each item, it offers step-by-step instructions, images and important parameters to keep in mind. It does not grant you the skill or ability to use your creations, nor does it provide access to brewing, enchanting, or other supernatural capabilities.

gate_making.name: Gate Making
gate_making.description: You possess the skills, basic theoretical knowledge, and practical capability to construct functional portals leading to the Nether and the End, even if the world you currently inhabit does not naturally connect to these dimensions. By gathering the proper materials and following the correct construction methods, you can create stable gateways to both realms. However, your expertise is limited to these two specific portal types - you cannot build custom variations, modify their destinations, or create gateways to other dimensions without additional perks or abilities.

jack_of_basic_trades.name: Jack of Basic Trades
jack_of_basic_trades.description: You possess basic skills and practical knowledge across a wide variety of disciplines, including farming, animal husbandry, riding, mining, cartography, fishing, and more. Essentially, anything mundane an average player can accomplish in the vamilla Minecraft game, you can now attempt at a basic, functional level. Chopping down a tree, constructing a simple shelter, or hunting wild game for food are well within your reach. While you are capable enough to get by and handle everyday tasks, you remain an amateur in all these fields - competent, but unrefined. Still, having a broad foundation is far better than starting with nothing at all.

structural_know-how.name: Structural Know-how
structural_know-how.description: You are a skilled architect and builder, possessing both the practical expertise and the theoretical knowledge required to construct any naturally generated Minecraft structure - from humble villages and abandoned mineshafts to woodland mansions and strongholds. You carry complete mental blueprints of every build, allowing you to recreate them exactly or draw inspiration from their designs.

technically_infinite_dimensions.name: Technically Infinite Dimensions
technically_infinite_dimensions.description: This perk grants you the ability to modify existing Nether portals to access a vast and unpredictable variety of random dimensions, inspired by the Minecraft April Fools snapshot 20w14∞. By applying wild magic principles to a standard portal frame, you can destabilize its destination, opening gateways to strange new realms. You never know what awaits on the other side before stepping through - it could be wondrous, dangerous, or simply bizarre. The beauty of applied wild magic!

vanilla_brewing.name: Vanilla Brewing
vanilla_brewing.description: This perk grants you the ability to utilize magic for Minecraft-style brewing, along with a natural talent for the craft and a scholarly intuition for its underlying principles. You gain a comprehensive understanding of the general theory behind the brewing process and learn how to apply potions in both conventional and creative ways. While this perk does not provide you with any specific recipes, it allows you to freely experiment, test new brews, and modify existing blueprints in your possession far beyond the limitations of the original game. Mastery of this perk is required to use a brewing stand effectively.

vanilla_enchanting.name: Vanilla  Enchanting
vanilla_enchanting.description: This perk grants you the ability to utilize magic for the Minecraft-style art of enchantment, along with a natural talent for the craft and a scholarly intuition for its underlying principles. You gain a comprehensive understanding of the general theory behind the enchanting process and learn how to apply enchanted items in both conventional and creative ways. While this perk does not provide you with any specific enchantment recipes, it allows you to freely experiment, test applications on different items, and modify existing blueprints in your possession far beyond the limitations of the original game. Mastery of this perk is required to use an enchanting table effectively.

vanilla_golems.name: Vanilla Golems
vanilla_golems.description: You possess a supernatural talent, theoretical background knowledge, and practical skill in the construction of golems. Your expertise currently includes complete blueprints for all golem types present in the vanilla game - snow, iron and copper. Golems you create are inherently aligned with you and will follow your orders to the best of their ability, though their intelligence is limited to their primary function, making them susceptible to trickery or distraction. When not given direct commands, they default to their basic innate programming - such as patrolling, protecting an area, or simply remaining idle until needed.

villager_trades.name: Villager Trades
villager_trades.description: You gain an average level of skill in haggling and the principles of primitive commerce, allowing you to barter effectively in markets that deal in goods rather than currency. Additionally, upon acquiring this perk, you receive above-average level skill and practical knowledge in one villager profession of your choice from the list below. You may pay an additional 100 CP (or wait for this perk to be rolled again) to gain expertise in another profession, repeating the process until you have mastered them all. >Villager Professions: Armorer, Butcher, Cartographer, Cleric, Farmer, Fisherman, Fletcher, Leatherworker, Librarian, Mason, Shepherd, Toolsmith, Weaponsmith.

active_countermeasures.name: Active Countermeasures
active_countermeasures.description: "The best defense is a good offense." You are an expert in the planning and construction of point-defense systems, specializing in Sentinel-class technology. While relatively primitive by interstellar standards, your expertise allows you to maximize their effectiveness against incoming projectiles and missiles. Your knowledge covers both the theoretical and practical aspects of active defense, from optimal placement and targeting algorithms to maintenance and rapid fabrication. A solid foundation upon which to build more advanced countermeasures.

alien_topography.name: Alien Topography
alien_topography.description: "Civilizations flourish in locations that promote growth. By analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive, we can gain more out of our own colonies." You possess a deep understanding of how alien species interact with their environments. You can analyze settlement patterns and geographical data to identify optimal locations for colonies, maximizing their growth and potential.

archaeostudies_tree.name: Archaeostudies Tree
archaeostudies_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Archaeostudies Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 300 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Events.

baol_organic_plant.name: Baol Organic Plant
baol_organic_plant.description: "The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops." You possess the knowledge and genetic templates to create Baol-style organic plantations - hybrid facilities that function as both orchard and factory. These living structures can be calibrated to grow tools, commodities, and other useful items directly from organic matter, alongside regular crops. With proper adjustments, your plantations become self-sustaining production centers, silently and steadily yielding whatever you need with minimal oversight.

bio-integrated_combat_computing.name: Bio-Integrated Combat Computing
bio-integrated_combat_computing.description: "We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in fleet combat. Additionally, the diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our technologies with minimal harm to the organism." You possess the knowledge to seamlessly integrate advanced computing technology with living spaceborne organisms. You can create neurochips that allow you to direct the behavior of space fauna during large-scale combat, while also enhancing their natural sensory organs with technological augmentations. All without causing significant harm to the creatures themselves.

biology_tree.name: Biology Tree
biology_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Biology Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 250 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

chemical_thrusters.name: Chemical Thrusters
chemical_thrusters.description: "Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function." You possess a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions for planning, building, operating, and maintaining chemical thrusters at a future civilization's technology level. However, your knowledge is purely theoretical - you have no practical skills or hands-on experience to accompany it.

computing_tree.name: Computing Tree
computing_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Computing Tech Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 250 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

corvettes.name: Corvettes
corvettes.description: "The corvette is the most basic military ship, armed and ready in the event of hostile contact." You can build, maintain, and operate a corvette-class vessel, provided you have the suitable tools and materials on hand. However, your knowledge is primarily practical: you lack an extensive theoretical background on why it is constructed in this particular way.

cybrex_mining_hub.name: Cybrex Mining Hub
cybrex_mining_hub.description: "To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could outfit our own mining drones, so that we might put their millennia-old algorithms to good use." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct mining drones equipped with Cybrex-derived memory chips and sensors. These drones utilize ancient, highly efficient algorithms to survey and harvest orbital resources with exceptional speed and precision. Whether applied to asteroid belts, planetary rings, or other celestial bodies, your mining operations become drastically more productive. The technology is self-contained and adaptable, allowing you to outfit existing drone frameworks or build new ones from scratch.

dark_matter_deflectors.name: Dark Matter Deflectors
dark_matter_deflectors.description: "These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature." You possess a complete understanding of Dark Matter Deflector technology. These advanced shields utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that defies the known laws of physics, offering superior protection. You gain the theoretical knowledge and practical skills necessary to construct, maintain, and utilize these deflectors reliably. You still require the proper tools and facilities to build them and you have no idea how to do it!

dark_matter_power.name: Dark Matter Power
dark_matter_power.description: "These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics." You possess the theoretical knowledge of Dark Matter Power generation: technology that draws energy directly from dark matter to provide far more power than should be physically possible. When attempting to construct these immensely complicated power generating devices, you have a supernatural advantage that guides your efforts. This won't make the task easy, but it gives you an edge in navigating the incredible complexity involved.

dark_matter_propulsion.name: Dark Matter Propulsion
dark_matter_propulsion.description: "These thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics." You possess the schematics and understanding needed to construct and integrate these exotic thrusters into your ships. They offer unparalleled speed and maneuverability by harnessing the reactive properties of dark matter.

deep_space_defenses.name: Deep Space Defenses
deep_space_defenses.description: "This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our starbases." You know how to build, operate, maintain, and modify simple defensive deep space platforms, allowing you to establish basic orbital fortifications around key locations. It's equivalent of receiving good education and apply it practically for a few years.

deflectors.name: Deflectors
deflectors.description: "Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power." You gain comprehensive insight into deflector technology, including the theoretical principles behind energy shielding and several practical blueprints for implementation. Your knowledge allows you to construct, install, and maintain deflector systems capable of absorbing enemy fire until overload. A solid foundation in personal or ship-scale defense, tempered by the eternal challenge of balancing protection against power consumption.

dimensional_transcendentalism.name: Dimensional Transcendentalism
dimensional_transcendentalism.description: You have unlocked the secrets of dimensional transcendentalism, allowing you to construct ships whose interiors are vastly larger than their exteriors suggest. This "bigger-on-the-inside" principle grants your vessels immense firepower and capability at a fraction of the expected logistical cost. This knowledge applies across your fleet, from the modest Riddle Escort and the imposing Enigma Battlecruiser (which outclasses standard battleships) to the nigh-impregnable Paradox Titan, a mobile fortress that can shrug off all but the most brutal assaults.

dyson_sphere_for_dummies.name: Dyson Sphere for Dummies
dyson_sphere_for_dummies.description: Your mind now contains a comprehensive and highly detailed plan for constructing a Dyson Sphere - a megastructure designed to fully envelop a star and convert its entire energy output into usable power. This mental blueprint is easily accessible and outlines a step-by-step process, starting from the industrial capabilities of modern Earth and incorporating every conceivable shortcut to achieve this monumental goal. It doesn't put things like actual need for Dyson Sphere, ethics of each step or other important issues into account. Actually acquiring the resources and putting this information into practice is still up to you.

energy_burster.name: Energy Burster
energy_burster.description: "Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Energy Burster devices are now part of your mental library. These unique bio-projectiles release controlled energy bursts on impact, providing a subtle boost to your vessels' maneuverability during combat. A unconventional tool for those who prefer to turn every engagement into an opportunity for tactical repositioning.

enigmatic_decoding_and_encoding.name: Enigmatic Decoding & Encoding
enigmatic_decoding_and_encoding.description: "While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of the Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic. Conversely, the Enigmatic Encoder scrambles our own flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command." You possess the knowledge to construct, operate, and integrate both Enigmatic Decoder and Encoder systems. Your decoding technology becomes more accurate the more seemingly unpredictable the target's movements, while your encoding systems scramble your own flight data in ways that defy analysis. Together, these technologies grant your fleet unparalleled predictive targeting and defensive evasion.

extradimensional_weaponry.name: Extradimensional Weaponry
extradimensional_weaponry.description: "Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons." You possess a mental compendium of fundamental knowledge and practical experiments needed to begin researching these kinds of weapons. You gain a supernatural advantage and sudden strikes of insight when actively working on this technology.

field_manipulation_tree.name: Field Manipulation Tree
field_manipulation_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Field Manipulation Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 250 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

first_league_filing_offices.name: First League Filing Offices
first_league_filing_offices.description: "The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct quantic filing arrays based on First League technology. These systems organize, store, and retrieve documents with seemingly impossible efficiency, transforming even the most chaotic archives into perfectly structured databases. Whether applied to government records, corporate data, or personal libraries, your filing systems ensure that any piece of information can be located, cross-referenced, and accessed in moments - no matter how vast the collection grows.

fission_power.name: Fission Power
fission_power.description: "This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste." You possess the equivalent of a higher education in fission power generation, as understood by a futuristic society. Your knowledge covers reactor design, fuel processing, and waste management, allowing you to construct and maintain efficient fission systems for ships or settlements. Your skills are average by the standards of this advanced society, but your expertise is narrowly focused. While you understand fission power thoroughly, you have significant gaps in your knowledge of other fields.

flak_battery.name: Flak Battery
flak_battery.description: "Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles." You possess a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions for planning, building, operating, and maintaining flak battery weaponry at a future civilization's technology level. However, your knowledge is purely theoretical - you have no practical skills or hands-on experience to accompany it.

fruit_gardens.name: Fruit Gardens
fruit_gardens.description: "Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna." You possess the knowledge to construct vacuum-sealed gardens and bio-engineer a variety of organisms specifically designed to thrive within them. These fruits are genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna, allowing you to study, lure, or interact with creatures that dwell in the void between worlds. A unique fusion of agriculture and xenobiology, opening doors to peaceful contact or controlled observation of deep-space lifeforms.

gravity-assist_logistics.name: Gravity-Assist Logistics
gravity-assist_logistics.description: You possess an intuitive genius for gravity-assisted astrogation. You have the theoretical and practical knowledge to calculate perfect slingshot maneuvers, using planetary gravity wells to achieve maximum velocity with minimal fuel. This talent extends to logistics; your deep understanding of orbital mechanics allows you to position yourself or any craft you pilot with such efficiency that you can perform complex missions with a fraction of the typical resource expenditure. Wherever you fly, your fuel efficiency and maneuverability are simply superior.

high-energy_capacitors.name: High-Energy Capacitors
high-energy_capacitors.description: "Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy are one of the cornerstones of any modern civilization." You possess the theoretical knowledge, blueprints, and practical skills needed to produce and utilize high-energy capacitors. Your expertise covers multiple variations of this essential technology, allowing you to store and discharge tremendous amounts of power for weapons, propulsion, or infrastructure. A foundational technology that opens the door to more advanced energy systems.

holo-entertainment.name: Holo-Entertainment
holo-entertainment.description: "The latest in holographic entertainment. Entire worlds built out of photons and energy fields." You are an average-skilled expert in holo-engineering and design. You know how to create, maintain, and operate immersive holographic environments for recreation, education, or simulation purposes.

hyperspace_travel.name: Hyperspace Travel
hyperspace_travel.description: "Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster-than-light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes." You gain insight into the theory of hyperspace travel, including the principles that govern this extra-dimensional realm and its connection to stellar gravity wells. Your knowledge is accompanied by blueprints for experimental devices capable of proving key aspects of the theory. While true FTL travel remains beyond your immediate reach, this perk provides the foundation needed to begin mapping hyperlanes and developing the technology to navigate them.

industrial_agriculture.name: Industrial Agriculture
industrial_agriculture.description: "Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allow a civilization to increase its population manifold." You possess the expertise of someone who has run and overseen the construction of large-scale industrial farms. Your knowledge covers efficient cultivation, infrastructure planning, and resource management necessary to feed a growing population. While modest by futuristic standards, this foundational skill ensures food security and the capacity to support expansion wherever you settle.

industrial_base.name: Industrial Base
industrial_base.description: "The basic industrial infrastructure required to become a spacefaring civilization." You possess an extensive theoretical foundation and exceptional talent for planning and constructing fundamental industrial infrastructure at the level of a future society. While you do not carry specific blueprints, your deep understanding allows you to design and oversee the building of factories, foundries, and manufacturing networks from the ground up.

industry_tree.name: Industry Tree
industry_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Industry Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 300 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

interplanetary_commerce.name: Interplanetary Commerce
interplanetary_commerce.description: "With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming." You are an average-skilled expert in interplanetary trade and commerce. You understand the logistics, regulations, and financial strategies involved in moving goods and services across star systems.

interplanetary_expeditionary_forces.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
interplanetary_expeditionary_forces.description: "The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies." You have received education in the military logistics required to support interplanetary forces. You understand the complex supply chains, transport requirements, and coordination needed to sustain military operations across star systems.

irassian_naval_yards.name: Irassian Naval Yards
irassian_naval_yards.description: "The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct shipyards utilizing Irassian astronaval technology. Your facilities can produce a constant, rapid stream of vessels for both military and civilian purposes, matching the legendary output of the Irassian empire at its height. This perk grants you their unparalleled production efficiency and ship design principles. However, it comes with a silent warning: be mindful of overreliance on any single system, lest you share their fate.

leviathan_tech_genesis.name: Leviathan Tech Genesis
leviathan_tech_genesis.description: "Utilizing the recovered knowledge seized from leviathans, we now have access to new improvements for our frames." You possess the secrets extracted from ancient cosmic leviathans. This knowledge allows you to integrate their otherworldly biology and technology into your own constructions, granting them unprecedented enhancements and capabilities far beyond conventional designs.

lost_building_methods.name: Lost Building Methods
lost_building_methods.description: "Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients, which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us, we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds." You have studied and preserved the construction techniques of ancient civilizations. You know how to recreate their lost architectural marvels, allowing you to build structures using methods and materials that have long since faded from memory and getting useful insights from them.

mass_drivers.name: Mass Drivers
mass_drivers.description: "These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds toward targets at high speeds." You can build a mass driver from scratch and modify it in a few ways, but you do not actually understand the fundamental physics of how they work. Your knowledge is purely practical - you know how to make, operate, and maintain them, but not the theory behind it.

matter_decompressor_project.name: Matter Decompressor Project
matter_decompressor_project.description: You receive a fiat-backed dataslate containing incredibly detailed instructions for constructing a Matter Decompressor - a megastructure that uses a black hole's gravity as a drill to extract virtually unlimited minerals from the singularity itself. The blueprint touches a bit on fundamental theory but primarily serves as a practical, step-by-step guide to achieving this goal under a range of varying circumstances. It assumes the reader possesses the necessary foundational knowledge, focusing instead on the actual construction process. It is easily accessible by computers of practically any architecture and will come back into your possession some time after, if destroyed.

maulers.name: Maulers
maulers.description: "Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Mauler-class bioships are now part of your mental library. These living vessels are fully space-faring and capable of faster-than-light travel, designed for military applications. You also possess average piloting skills sufficient to operate one effectively. Whether grown in orbital habitats or tailored for specific roles, these organic craft offer a unique alternative to traditional shipbuilding.

mechanized_mining.name: Mechanized Mining
mechanized_mining.description: "The basic industrial infrastructure required to become a spacefaring civilization." You possess a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions for planning, building, operating, and maintaining the foundational industrial infrastructure of a future civilization. However, your knowledge is purely theoretical - you have no practical skills or hands-on experience to accompany it.

medical_care.name: Medical Care
medical_care.description: "A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. However, sometimes both are needed." You are a fully trained physician with medical education equivalent to that of a futuristic society. Your skills cover diagnosis, treatment, and preventive care at a level considered average by their advanced standards. While you lack specialized knowledge in other fields, your medical expertise ensures that you (and those under your care) benefit from healthcare centuries ahead of modern Earth.

nanite_repair_system.name: Nanite Repair System
nanite_repair_system.description: This nanite repair system is a highly effective auto-repair mechanism comprised of billions of microscopic repair machines. Originally salvaged from the wreckage of the Scavenger, this technology has been repurposed for your use. You gain a sealed, dormant sample of this advanced technology, along with an incredibly detailed and comprehensive guide on how to activate, utilize, and reproduce it for your own vessels and equipment.

nanocomposite_materials.name: Nanocomposite Materials
nanocomposite_materials.description: "Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could mean the difference between life and death in a combat situation." You are an expert in the field of nanocomposite materials. You know how to fabricate and apply them, and you understand the fundamental theory behind how they work at a molecular level.

new_worlds_protocol.name: New Worlds Protocol
new_worlds_protocol.description: "Calculating the required resources and gear needed to establish a planetary colony allows us to send brave pioneers forth in grand ark ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home." You possess a working knowledge of standard New World Protocols. This grants you the foundational skills and administrative know-how to plan, organize, and oversee the establishment of new colonies, ensuring that pioneering efforts have the infrastructure and supplies necessary to survive and take root on an unsettled world.

nuclear_missiles.description: "Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range." You possess a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions for planning, building, operating, and maintaining space-to-space nuclear missile weaponry at a future civilization's technology level. However, your knowledge is purely theoretical - you have no practical skills or hands-on experience to accompany it.

offworld_construction.name: Offworld Construction
offworld_construction.description: "Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds." You possess an extensive theoretical foundation and exceptional talent for planning and executing offworld construction projects at the level of a future society. While you carry no specific blueprints, your deep understanding allows you to design and oversee the building of orbital platforms, space stations, and other zero-gravity structures from first principles.

orbital_energy_conversion.name: Orbital Energy Conversion
orbital_energy_conversion.description: "Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however." You know how to build, operate, maintain, and modify orbital solar panels of this scale. You also understand the basic theory behind their inner workings, allowing you to adapt and improve the technology as needed.

planetary_defenses.name: Planetary Defenses
planetary_defenses.description: "There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready." You are an expert of average skill in planetary defense planning and oversight. Your knowledge covers the strategic placement of defensive installations, coordination of ground-based systems, and preparation of civilian infrastructure to withstand orbital bombardment or invasion. While not a master strategist, you possess the foundational competence needed to make any world a harder target. Vigilance is the price of survival.

planetary_germination.name: Planetary Germination
planetary_germination.description: "To spread our roots to a new world, we must first prepare the seedbed. By terraforming a planet, we can ensure that our colonies get off to a healthy start." You are an expert of average skill in the field of planetary engineering. You are capable of overseeing and assisting in the planning of large-scale terraforming and colonization projects, ensuring that a barren world can be made ready to support new life.

planetary_government.name: Planetary Government
planetary_government.description: "Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers become citizens, the need for a strong local government to provide stability outweighs the colonial need for flexibility." You are an expert in the field of planetary governance, possessing an average level of education by the standards of a future individualist society. You know how to establish and run effective administrative systems to ensure a stable and prosperous world.

planetary_instantiation.name: Planetary Instantiation
planetary_instantiation.description: "Our colonies would never achieve stable operation without infrastructure dedicated to our networked self." You possess theoretical knowledge and a natural talent for the governing practices of a machine intelligence hive mind. You understand how to integrate a planetary population into a single networked consciousness, ensuring smooth and stable operation across all systems.

planetary_plexus.name: Planetary Plexus
planetary_plexus.description: "Our colonies would wither to naught without the stable projection of our collective self. Our effortless presence ensures a flourishing hive." You possess theoretical knowledge and a natural talent for the governing practices of a hive mind society. You understand how to manage a planetary population as a single, cohesive entity, ensuring the stability and prosperity of the collective.

predatory_tactics.name: Predatory Tactics
predatory_tactics.description: "Just as clever pre-FTL hunters move to conceal themselves while approaching prey, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field." You understand the art of stealth movement in combat. You know how to coordinate forces to maneuver at increased speed while maintaining active camouflage, allowing strikes that are both swift and undetected.

reactor_boosters.name: Reactor Boosters
reactor_boosters.description: "Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output." You gain blueprints and a basic theoretical understanding sufficient to construct Reactor Boosters yourself. These supplementary systems can be integrated into existing power plants to increase overall energy output, providing the extra capacity needed for more demanding weapons, shields, or propulsion systems. A simple but valuable upgrade for any vessel straining against its power limits.

red_lasers.name: Red Lasers
red_lasers.description: "Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat." You are a skilled engineer specializing in the maintenance and construction of Red Laser weapons. Your expertise covers the full lifecycle of these systems, from fabrication and calibration to field repairs and performance optimization. While relatively basic by interstellar standards, your knowledge ensures these weapons function at peak efficiency - delivering concentrated thermal damage with reliable precision.

scientific_method.name: Scientific Method
scientific_method.description: "Testable predictions of observable phenomena." You possess the equivalent of a higher education in scientific methodology, specifically as taught by a society centuries ahead of modern humanity. You understand how to apply advanced research techniques, experimental design, and data analysis from a futuristic civilization to your work. This knowledge provides a significant edge in structuring research and inquiry, helping you avoid dead ends and recognize meaningful patterns. However, this is a narrow field of expertise. While your grasp of the method is on par with that advanced society, your actual knowledge of specific technologies, history, and context beyond this discipline remains mostly blank. It also doesn't enchance your intellenge.

sociocultural_history.name: Sociocultural History
sociocultural_history.description: "An understanding of our shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future." You are an expert historian and monument builder of average skill from a future society. You know how to preserve cultural heritage, document historical events, and design lasting monuments that inspire and educate future generations.

space_exploration.name: Space Exploration
space_exploration.description: "The Science Ship is used as a base of operations for a top scientist, ready to explore the vastness of space." You can build, maintain, and operate a science vessel of this caliber, provided you have the suitable tools and materials on hand. However, your knowledge is primarily practical - you lack an extensive theoretical background on why the ship is constructed in this particular way.

starbase_construction.name: Starbase Construction
starbase_construction.description: "A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system's primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system." You can build, maintain, and operate a starbase of this scale, provided you have the suitable tools and materials on hand. However, your knowledge is primarily practical: you lack an extensive theoretical background on why the base is constructed in this particular way.

starport.name: Starport
starport.description: "The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems." You can build, maintain, and operate a permanent starport of this caliber, provided you have the suitable tools and materials on hand. However, your knowledge is primarily practical: you lack an extensive theoretical background on why it is constructed in this particular way.
