Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 300 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

stellaris_species.name: Stellaris Species
stellaris_species.description: You are an expert focused on the biology of the many sentient species found throughout the Stellaris universe, including those from various species packs. Your scientific knowledge of their diverse and unique physiologies is extensive and profound, allowing you to understand, interact with, and potentially even engineer solutions tailored to their specific biological needs.

subspace_drive.name: Subspace Drive
subspace_drive.description: "An insight born of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jump-start our galactic exploration." You gain the blueprints and practical skills necessary to initiate and complete the Subspace Drive engine megaproject. This knowledge allows you to construct drives capable of limited interstellar jumps - enough to reach nearby systems and begin true galactic exploration. However, your understanding is purely practical. You possess nearly no theoretical context beyond what is needed to build and operate the drives, leaving the deeper science of subspace as a mystery to be solved another day.

synaptic_structures.name: Synaptic Structures
synaptic_structures.description: "Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened." You possess the blueprints and operational instructions for constructing and maintaining various synaptic structures essential to a hive mind society. You know how to build the neural architecture that allows a collective consciousness to function across an entire planet.

the_celestial_code.name: The Celestial Code
the_celestial_code.description: Your understanding has transcended conventional science, allowing you to perceive reality as a complex, layered code of physics and spacetime. By mastering the art of precise, microscopic alterations to gravity - injecting commands into the fundamental framework of existence - you can now perform temporary edits to the rules of reality itself. However, these changes are fleeting. To make your modifications permanent, you must engineer a vessel or construct capable of piercing the fabric of spacetime and surviving the journey through nascent universes. Only by anchoring your will across dimensions can you make your revisions to the cosmic source code absolute.

vector_lock_cannon.name: Vector Lock Cannon
vector_lock_cannon.description: "Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Vector Lock Cannon munitions are now part of your mental library. These biologically enhanced projectiles actively counter evasive maneuvers, making them exceptionally effective against agile targets. A precision tool for hunters who refuse to let their quarry slip away.

voidcraft_tree.name: Voidcraft Tree
voidcraft_tree.description: You possess the unnatural ability to rapidly research and discover technologies from the Voidcraft Tree of the Stellaris game. Your progression is semi-random, utilizing a "card shuffle" approach where new inspirations arise based on your recent actions. To advance, you must create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others, and remain proactive in your research. Your activities make certain technologies more likely to appear the next time inspiration strikes, allowing you to subtly guide your progression. You may pay an additional 250 CP (half the base price) at any time (either now or the next time you get this perk) to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you wish, provided you have the points to spare. Each purchase grants an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest-tier technologies still ahead of you in this tree (typically one or two). This option does not include Starter Technologies or Events.

vultaum_reality_computer.name: Vultaum Reality Computer
vultaum_reality_computer.description: "The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself - not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct a Vultaum Reality Computer - a processing unit designed to analyze the fundamental nature of existence. Rather than studying physical laws, this computer attempts to reverse engineer reality's underlying "code," searching for inconsistencies, glitches, or patterns that might reveal the true nature of your world. While it cannot guarantee answers, it provides unparalleled insight into the metaphysical and the simulated, should such things exist.

weavers.name: Weavers
weavers.description: "Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities." Blueprints and the practical skills to grow/create Weaver-class bioships are now part of your mental library. These living vessels refine earlier bio-engineering techniques, striking an elegant balance between agility and combat performance. You also possess average piloting skills sufficient to operate one effectively.

xenological_computation.name: Xenological Computation
xenological_computation.description: "After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have introduced entirely new numbers into our mathematics and made it easier to adapt to foreign empires' structures." You have absorbed the computational paradigms of countless alien civilizations. You understand alternative mathematical systems that introduce entirely new numerical concepts, as well as trinary and other non-binary computing architectures. This knowledge allows you to adapt seamlessly to foreign computational and logistical structures, whether for code-breaking, integration, or cultural understanding.

yuht_astronomical_interferometer.name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer
yuht_astronomical_interferometer.description: "The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays." You possess the knowledge and schematics to construct and calibrate Yuht astronomical interferometers - powerful detection arrays originally designed to disprove the existence of alien life. With your modifications, these instruments shed their built-in bias and become exceptional tools for deep-space observation. They excel at detecting celestial phenomena, distant objects, and potential signs of other life, providing clarity and range far beyond conventional sensors.

zroni_storm_caster.name: Zroni Storm Caster
zroni_storm_caster.description: "Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems." You possess the knowledge and artifacts needed to harness the volatile element Zro, allowing you to generate and control massive spatial storms.These chaotic energy storms can be deployed across entire solar systems, disrupting sensors, damaging unshielded vessels, and reshaping local space to your advantage. With practice and sufficient Zro, you can learn to direct these storms with increasing precision, turning raw chaos into a strategic tool.

advanced_decorations.name: Advanced Decorations
advanced_decorations.description: You gain the knowledge and skills needed to craft the various pieces of furniture and decorative items from Terraria that require a Sawmill and Heavy Assembler as crafting stations. This includes bookcases, chandeliers, clocks, and other fine decorative pieces. It includes heavy decorations such as statues, masonry and chests. This perk also comes with a great sense of style and natural furnishing skills, ensuring your creations are not only functional but also placed right aesthetically, allowing you to turn any space into a beautifully appointed home.

benched.name: Benched
benched.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of all crafting station variations from Terraria along with the required degree of skill to construct them from raw materials. Additionally, you possess perfect knowledge of every item recipe that can be crafted using these stations, allowing you to produce their associated goods wherever you have the necessary materials, specific tools and a suitable surface to work upon.

bottled_magics.name: Bottled Magics
bottled_magics.description: This perk grants you the ability to practice the art of Terraria-style alchemical brewing, along with a natural talent for the craft and a scholarly intuition for its underlying magical principles. You gain a comprehensive understanding of the general theory behind the brewing process (from ingredient properties to extraction methods) and learn how to apply potions in both conventional and creative ways. You possess a complete mental compendium of every craftable potion and flask recipe from Terraria, as well as the skills required to construct all necessary tools and crafting stations.

bottomless_shimmer_bucket.name: Bottomless Shimmer Bucket
bottomless_shimmer_bucket.description: This mysterious magical item can be used to pour out an infinite amount of Shimmer: a shiny, lavender-colored, pearlescent liquid with some rather special properties. Found within the depths of Terraria, Shimmer is known for its unique transmutative abilities, capable of transforming items, creatures, and even the environment itself in wondrous and unexpected ways. With this bottomless bucket, you will never run out of this remarkable fluid.

by_hand.name: By Hand
by_hand.description: You possess extraordinary dexterous and steady hands, and the ability to craft items on the fly without the use of specialized instruments or crafting stations. This grants you a supernatural advantage when creating simple things that could hypothetically be made entirely by hand, using only the environment to assist you. This perk comes with a complete mental compendium of all blueprints for items that can be crafted without a crafting station in Terraria, allowing you to produce torches, wooden tools, basic armor, and other essentials from raw materials, no matter where you find yourself.

cooking_pot.name: Cooking Pot
cooking_pot.description: You gain the skills required to craft all cooking tools along with the knowledge to prepare any food item from the Terraria game. Any dish you create can be imbued with temporary positive effects, inspired by the food buffs found in Terraria. Additionally, you possess a natural knack for working with unusual or exotic ingredients, allowing you to experiment with local flora and fauna to discover new recipes and beneficial effects wherever your journey takes you.

hardmode_creations.name: Hardmode Creations
hardmode_creations.description: You gain the ability to craft all items, equipment, and items from the Hardmode tier of the Terraria game including endgame weapons, armor, tools, and accessories. This perk provides a complete mental compendium of every Hardmode blueprint, along with the enhanced skill and knowledge required to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and magical properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature and magical essence from other worlds.

heavy_metal.name: Heavy Metal
heavy_metal.description: This perk grants you the skills needed to construct any pre-Hardmode anvil from Terraria, along with masterful skill in using them to work various metals into finished products. You possess a complete mental compendium of every item blueprint from the game that requires a pre-Hardmode anvil as a crafting station, allowing you to produce a wide array of tools, weapons, and armor from your carefully smelted metal bars.

im_smelting.name: I'm Smelting!
im_smelting.description: This perk grants you the ability to construct many furnace variants inspired by Terraria (inluding the Hellforge) along with a masterful degree of skill in smelting and extracting metals from raw ores using different furnace setups. You possess a complete mental compendium of every recipe from the game that utilizes the Furnace and Hellforge as crafting stations, ensuring you know exactly how to transform your freshly mined ores into bars and alloys, and making some other miscellaneous items.

many_silks.name: Many Silks
many_silks.description: You know how to construct a loom and possess the professional skill to use it in creating various cloth-based items. This perk provides a complete mental compendium of every fabric-based item from Terraria (including silk, banners, clothing, and accessories) allowing you to craft them from raw materials. Additionally, this perk includes the knowledge, skills, and a small degree of magical ability required to craft the full range of dyes and paints from Terraria. You can produce vibrant colors from local flora, fauna, and minerals, and you have the expertise to apply these pigments to your other creations with professional and stylish results.

more_life.name: More Life
more_life.description: This perk grants you the equivalent of one Life Crystal or Life Fruit use, depending on how many times you have already purchased it. Each purchase permanently increases your life energy and enhances your ability to survive damage. This perk may be purchased multiple times - up to 35 times in total. The first 15 purchases function as Life Crystal equivalents, providing a solid foundation of increased vitality. The subsequent 20 purchases function as Life Fruit equivalents, further enhancing your maximum life beyond the initial threshold.

more_magic.name: More Magic
more_magic.description: This perk grants you the equivalent of one Mana Crystal use, permanently expanding your magical reserves. The first purchase awakens your connection to Terraria-style mana, granting you access to this energy system for the first time. Each subsequent purchase makes your mana reserves a little bit larger. This perk may be purchased multiple times (up to 10 times in total) allowing you to build a substantial well of magical energy to power spells and enchanted items.

summoned_help.name: Summoned Help
summoned_help.description: You gain the ability to craft all items used for summoning pets and mounts from the Terraria game, along with the skills needed to command and control them effectively. Their special properties (including unique behaviors, abilities, and appearances) are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every pet and mount summoning item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and magical properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

summoning_altars.name: Summoning Altars
summoning_altars.description: This perk grants you the ability and skills needed to create all pre-Hardmode boss-summoning items from Terraria, along with the legendary blade Night's Edge, the Void Bag, and the Void Vault - all crafted using Altars. You also possess the knowledge required to construct these Altars themselves. Additionally, this perk includes sufficient magical aptitude to properly use boss-summoning items in rituals, allowing you to actually summon the corresponding Terraria boss. However, the success and behavior of these summonings may be somewhat limited or altered by the rules and metaphysical structure of your current reality.

the_corruption_spreads.name: The Corruption Spreads
the_corruption_spreads.description: This perk allows you to generate the Corruption biome from Terraria, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into a purple, blighted wasteland of decay and shadow. Once established, the Corruption will spread slowly outward over time, though the speed and effectiveness of this conversion depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the transformation. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge of the Corruption biome: its properties, creatures, resources, unique phenomena and to take advantage of them. You are also immune to the corrupting effects of the biome, though this does not protect you from its hostile inhabitants.

the_crimson_spreads.name: The Crimson Spreads
the_crimson_spreads.description: This perk allows you to generate the Crimson biome from Terraria, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into a fleshy, corrupted landscape of gore and horror. Once established, the Crimson will spread slowly outward over time, though the speed and effectiveness of this conversion depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the transformation. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge of the Crimson biome: its properties, creatures, resources, unique phenomena and to take advantage of them. You are also immune to the harmful effects of the Crimson, though this does not protect you from its native inhabitants.

the_hallow_spreads.name: The Hallow Spreads
the_hallow_spreads.description: This perk allows you to generate the Hallow biome from Terraria, transforming the area within a few kilometers around you into lands of light and dangerous purity. Once established, the Hallow will spread slowly outward over time, though the speed and effectiveness of this conversion depend heavily on the nature of the local environment (including native flora and fauna), the resistance of local materials, and geographical features that may hinder or accelerate the transformation. You may hold this effect in storage indefinitely, waiting until you find a suitable location before unleashing it. This perk may be purchased multiple times, with each additional purchase (discounted to 300 CP) stacking another held activation for later use. The first purchase of this perk grants you complete encyclopedic knowledge of the Hallow biome: its properties, creatures, resources, unique phenomena and to take advantage of them. You are also immune to the harmful effects of the Hallow, though this does not protect you from its native inhabitants.

tinkerers_workshop.name: Tinkerer's Workshop
tinkerers_workshop.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of accessories from the Terraria game (including unobtainable and hardcore variants). You possess a complete mental compendium of every accessory recipe, along with the enchanting skills needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these accessories using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting items to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency of a proper creation. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature and magical properties from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on accessories included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

we_are_rich.name: We Are Rich!
we_are_rich.description: This perk allows you to spawn (once) twelve fully stocked chests containing various coins, gems, and metal bars at a targeted location, without causing any damage or disruption to the surrounding area. If insufficient space exists for all twelve chests, fewer will spawn as space allows. The chests contain currency and Terraria-type resources, each retaining their unique properties from the game. The quantity of specific materials scales with their rarity and usefulness: early-game resources appear in greater abundance, while late-game materials are comparatively rarer. You may hold this effect indefinitely, activating it only when you find a suitable location. Stored activations can be stacked without limit, and this perk may be purchased multiple times to accumulate additional uses. If you possess perks for other Terraria mods, the chests will also include materials from those sources, appropriately mixed into the generation.
